tei:div.tei:p: zhwa dmar sku phreng lnga pa

dkon mchog yan lag gi lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /de nas zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa lnga pa ni/ dpal mkha' spyod dbang pos ma 'ongs rang gi skye ba lung bstan par/ sa tshigs kyi dbang du byas pa'i mthar spyod pa nor 'dzin skyong ba'i bur 'gyur zhes dang*/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtshos spyan snga rin po che nyid la/ gdul bya lhag ma'i don du khyod nyid ni// shar phyogs kong po'i yul du 'gro bar gyis// zhes bka' stsal pa dang*/ rje nyid kyis kyang*/ kla klo 'du zhing mchod rten yod pa'i sar// skyes nas rig gnas ma bslab shes par 'gyur// zhes sngon nas gang du sprul pa'i sku phyi ma ston pa'i gnas dang rang gi mtshan nyid gsungs pa ltar/ rje mi bskyod rdo rje'i drung du zhu phrin phul bar yang*/ dwags kong gi mtshams su mjal bar smon/ /zhes dang*/ la bla ma grags pa 'od zer ba grogs mched la/ nged rang sgar chen mjal 'phrad dwags kong gi mtshams sam/ kong po'i kha stod tsam du yong ba byed gsungs shing*/ rkyen nas rgyal po mtshan ldan gyis mjal du yong bar brtsams pa la/ khyed rang yar ma 'ong*/ nged myur du kong phyogs su 'ong bas/ nged rang 'phrad par yong gsung ba'i bka' shog stsal ba ltar/ gnas mchog dpal gyi tsā ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i 'dabs/ phu na kla klo 'du ba'i tshong dus yod cing*/ rje btsun sgam po'i tshems kyi mchod rten bzhugs pa'i nye char kong po'i sa stod rkyen zhol mo che'i dga' ldan khang gsar du rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa bod rje lha gcig gi gdung rigs yab rgyal po mtshan ldan dang*/ yum bsod nams sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su nying mtshams sbyor ba'i sprul pa'i rol gar 'dzin par mdzad de/ de'i tshe chos rje gong ma'i thugs rje khyab pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang ltas bzang gi snang ba gzigs/ yum gyi mnal lam du zla ba lag pas bzung ba dang*/ ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba'i dge sbyong zhi zhing dul ba nang du spyan drangs pa la sogs pa sdig sgrib dag pa'i mtshan ma du ma byung zhing*/

yum gyi lto nas yig drug gi sgra grags pa gzhan gyis thos pa dang*/ yul du phan pa'i chu glo bur du rdol ba dang*/ dgun kar me tog skyes pa dang*/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu med pa byung*/ de nas shing mo bya'i lo khrums zla'i tshes bcu'i tho rangs ltas bzang dang bcas sku bltams te/ de ma thag yum la gzigs shing bzhad mo mdzad/ de nas mdun na mar me yod pa la gzigs te zhal 'dzum mdzad pa dang*/ bltams nas zhag gnyis gsum tsam song ba na mi gzhan dang yab yum sogs ma nor bar mkhyen cing*/ de nas bzung byis pa chung ngu'i rnam 'gyur mi mnga' bar sku chen po'i ngang tshul lta bu'i lhun chags pa dang*/ nye 'khor du sha chang gi dri tsam byung ba la'ang mi mnyes pa'i tshul dang*/ phyag g.yon par phyag phreng gi rjes gsal por snang ba mthong bas kun ya mtshan du gyur te/ yab yum la sogs nye 'khor rnams kyis nged kyi sras 'di shin tu ya mtshan pa gcig snang bas rje karma pa la phul te chos byed du 'jug ces gros thag bcad nas mtshan yang zla ba chos skyes su gsol/ de nas zla ngo lnga tsam lon pa na yab kyis mtshan nas bos pa la/ a ā zhes gdangs ring pos gsung lan byon zhing*/ de phyin mtshan nas nam bos gsung lan 'byon pa dang*/ gar bzhugs su dri bzang gi ngad rtag par ldang zhing phal cher sku drang por bsrangs te bzhugs pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa bgrang du med/ de skabs dpal karma pa mtshungs med mi bskyod zhabs kong yul rnam thos rir bzhugs pa nyang kha ba rnams spyan 'dren zhus par/ rje'i zhal nas nged rang chos ma'i phyogs su 'gro dgos pa yong gsungs pa'i zhag 'ga' na 'or shod du sde 'khrugs ldang ba'i bsdum la spyan 'dren byung bas/ sgar pas nyang khar phebs dgos tshul zhus kyang*/ da lo chos ma'i phyogs su 'gro ba la don cher yod gsungs nas thag bcad de chos ma'i phyogs su sgar btegs/ 'or du phebs te/

der nyin gcig drung na sangs rgyas dpal grub pa gcig po yod pa la/ spyan snga rin po che'i sku'i skye sprul nye skor zhig la yod pa tshol duu phyin na rnyed 'ong gsungs par/ bshes gnyen pas/ sku'i skye ba yod na gsungs gsal por 'byon e yong zhus pas/ da lta snyigs ma'i dus dbang las gsung gsal por 'byon pa rang dka' e shes gsungs pa dang*/ yang nyin gcig ba yo bla ma dang*/ zur ri gdong slob dpon chos mdzad pa sogs sdeb gcig yod par rkyen phyogs su phyag mdzub gtad nas/ rkyen lung pa phyin gyi nye skor zhig na spyan snga rin po che'i sku skye yod/ de tshol bar ba yo bla ma khyod rkyen ba yo 'or shod sogs dbus ri 'di la bskor ba gcig gyis la tshol dang rnyed 'ong*/ gsungs pa la/ bla mas/ bu chung rnams la dris pas ni mi go tshur bshad ni mi shes zhus par/ 'o na ba yo nas nyin lam gcig gi sar song dang sku skye rnyed 'ong gsungs kyang bla mas sku rtsed 'dra ba gcig tu go ba las dang len ma byung bar snang*/ gzhan yang de dag skabs rje zhwa dmar na rim gong ma kun gyi rnam thar las brtsam pa'i gsung gleng gis dus 'da' ba zhig byung zhing*/ de nas sgar chen tsā ri bkra shis ljongs kyi gnas gzigs su phebs tshe rkyen nas yab rgyal po mtshan ldan dpon g.yog mjal du byung ba la/ rje'i zhal nas khyed la mi ngo du yod kyi dri rtsad gnang ba'i lan zhus par/ 'o na bu chung ba de nged la phul gsungs pas/ de drung du 'bul rtsis yin kyang da lta chung chung rang las med/ cher song tsa 'bul zhus pa na/ da lta len mi thong gsungs par/ rgyal pos da lta len thub pa med byis pa ma smin pa chung ngu yin pas lam du dka' ba dang ma la nu bzhin pa'ang yin zhus pas/ ma dang lhan cig tu bos shog gsungs nas/ 'bod du btang*/ rje'i zhal nas da ni zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa spyan snga ba rang re can du myur du 'byon yang yang gsungs shing dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma mdzad/

de nas sgar pa ba yor bzhugs pa der tshes bco lnga'i snga dro yab rgyal pos sprul pa'i sku spyan drangs te rje'i drung du byon pa gzim yol gyi nang du phebs ma thag sprul pa'i sku spyan gzhan du mi yol bar shin tu dad pa'i tshul gyis rje nyid la gzigs/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa nyid nas kyang sprul pa'i sku de la rab tu gzigs shing zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas gsung shugs chung ngus/ dpal mkha' spyod dbang po khong da ni tshul 'di lta bu zhig mdzad nas phebs byung*/ lar sa la bzhugs pa'i sems dpa' rnams kyang lus rten bzhin mdzad nas phebs pa mtshar che ang gsungs nas thugs shin tu dgyes pa dang cung zad skyo ba'i tshul yang mdzad/ de nas sprul pa'i sku nyid yab kyi pang na bzhugs bzhin gzim gur gyi mtha' dbus tshang mar dal bus gzigs shing*/ rten sgam gnyis la yun ring gzigs nas slar rje nyid la rtse gcig tu gzigs te dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma mdzad/ de'i tshe rje'i zhal nas/ bu chung 'di bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i dus nas tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags pa yin pas/ 'di'i ming dkon mchog yan lag ces bya ba yin no zhes mtshan gsol zhing*/ dbu skra gtsug phud gzhan gyis bregs par brtsams pa na sprul pa'i sku mi dgyes pa'i rnam pa bstan pas rje nyid kyi phyag gis bregs pa gnang bas de'i mod la dbu skra rang byir spu gris bzhar ba bzhin song bar/ de ma thag g.yas 'khyil du 'od dang ldan par skyes pa drung na yod pa dag gis kyang mngon sum mthong bas ya mtshan du gyur/ de nas skyabs 'gro dang thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas kyi bka' drin kyang stsal te/ sprul sku'i na bzar rje nyid kyi sku gzan bzhes 'phro gcig gnang nas/ yab rgyal por bu chung 'di re zhig sus kyang ma tshor bar gtsang sar bzhugs 'jug dgos/ skabs su bab tshe sgar nas spyan 'dren mi gtong yong*/ gsungs pa tsam las spyan snga rin po che'i sprul sku yin pa'i bka' gsal rang ma mdzad/

de nas sprul sku yab yum 'khor bcas rkyen du phebs shing*/ slar dgung lo gnyis kyi ngo mthong tsam bzhes tshe sgar pa phrag gi zur ri gdong du bzhugs skabs/ rkyen du yab rgyal por dkon mchog yan lag sgar du skyol/ brtag pa zhig bya dgos gsungs pa'i bka' shog mi sna gnang nas/ bka' shog dang bka' lung gi sgros gsan ma thag sprul pa'i sku shin tu dgyes pas yab yum gyi mdun du bzhad mo chen po mdzad cing*/ sgar du phebs spro pa'i nyams sna tshogs mdzad/ de nas yab yum mched zla sku 'khor shas cig dang bcas phebs te/ lam du rje chos dpal ye shes kyi dbon gyi khang par bzhugs pa na der spyan snga rin po che sngon phebs dus kyi gsol thab yod pa'i khang par phyag mdzub gtad te/ ja bskol gsungs pa'i brda' dang*/ sga ma mo gar yod sgar pa gar bzhugs sogs zhus par so so'i phyogs su phyag mdzub gtad nas 'di na yod kyi brda' sogs mdzad/ de nas phag lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi snga dro rje'i drung du mjal ba na gus pas phyag mang du mdzad de byin rlabs zhus nas bzhugs gdan la bzhugs te/ de ltar drung du sleb pa tsam gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i dga' spro dang mos gus skyes shes dgung lo bcu bzhi phan gyi rnam thar rje rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyis mdzad par yang gsungs/ der drung 'khor rnams la rje'i zhal nas/ brtag pa la sogs pa byed mi dgos kyang deng sang 'di 'dra zhig dar 'dug pas gzhan rnams yid ches pa'i phyir de ltar bya'o gsungs nas/ thog mar thel dmar brgyab pa'i yi ge 'ga' zhig phyag tu gtad nas gzhan rnams tshur thong*/ khyed rang gi gang yin pa longs gsungs pas/ spyan snga rin po che'i zhu yig phyag tu 'dzin nas 'bri khung dang dpon sa gong ma chen po'i zhu yig sogs gzhan rnams tshur phul/ de nas rdo rje gcod pa dang phyag chen lung sbyor gyi dpe gnyis gnang nas khyed rang gis brtsams pa gang yin zung gsungs pas phyag chen lung sbyor 'dzin nas gzigs pa'i tshul mdzad/

yang rdo rje gcod pa dang bon po'i dpe zhig gnang nas khyed cag gang la mos pa de zung gsungs pas rdo rje gcod pa phyag tu 'dzin cing*/ bon dpe bzhugs khri'i 'og tu phar 'phangs/ yang rje rol pa'i rdo rje dang dpal mkha' spyod pa'i sku gnyis gnang nas khyed rang gi sku gang yin gsungs pas gnyis ka phyag tu bsnams nas byin rlabs zhu ba mdzad pa la/ khyed rang gi sku zung gsungs pas/ mkha' spyod pa'i sku phyag tu bzung*/ de nga'i sku yin gsungs pas/ zhal 'dzum 'dzum mdzad cing shangs la phyag mdzub gtad nas nga yin gsungs/ drung gong ma'i gsol dpon chos dpal rgya mtsho la phyag gtad de ngos bzung ba dang*/ tshul khrims dpal gang red sogs zhus pas ngos bzung ba dang*/ de la sogs pa mang du ngos bzung ba dang*/ rdo rje dril bu la 'di ci red gsungs pas/ rdo rje g.yas su bsnams dril bu g.yon du bsnams nas rdo rje 'phyar zhing dril bu 'khrol ba dang*/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i khyad par du ma bstan pas der 'khod kun yid ches shing dad pa thob par gyur la/ de'i tshe rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyis kyang bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams zhal gzigs shing*/ bla ma gnyan ras kyi zhal nas/ rje sprul pa'i sku dam pa 'di'i tshul rjes su bstan pa ji ltar du gsan pa yang*/ nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i mthong nyid du// lha rnams me tog 'thor ba'i dbus dag nas// bka' brgyud rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gsal mthong zhing*// khyad par gnyan ras saṅgha lakṣa ni// mngon sum snang ste 'di skad gsungs pa thos// dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bka' yi srol// kaṃ tshang brgyud pa rin chen 'di nyid la// sngags 'chang rnal 'byor dpag med 'byung ba'i phyir// kaṃ tshang nang sel med pa'i rten 'brel dang*// skye bo mang po sdig pa spang ba'i thabs// khyod cag yun ring bar du bsams pa de// da lta'i dus 'dir bab ces bka' stsal pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po karma pa rnams dang*//

tshe rabs mang por yang yang rjes 'brel ba'i// skyes bu zhwa dmar can du grags pa ni// rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pa 'di nyid yin// zhes sogs sam ṭar phyag bris su mdzad nas dge bshes sangs rgyas dpal grub la gnang ste re zhig gsang bar bka' rgyas btab/ de nas nyin gcig yab rgyal po la rje'i zhal nas/ khyed kyi bu chung 'di sprul sku yin tshul rim gyis gsungs/ rjes 'di ltar gsungs pa dpon g.yog rnams kyis gleng mol byas pa sprul pa'i skus gsan te/ me tog sku rtsed mdzad 'phro la har gyis bzhengs nas nga yin nga yin gsungs nas zhal gyis bzhes te/ rnam thar tshig lhug mar/ khyod zhwa dmar ba'i sku skye yin gsungs pas bdag kyang yin snyam pa'i yus kyis brnangs pa ltar gyur nas mchi ma dbang med du shor gsungs shing*/ spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i rtogs brjod las/ lha sa'i jo bor smon lam mdzad pa na// de tshe bco lnga'i dus kyi rmi lam du// rin chen ind+ra nī la 'od 'bar ba// dbyibs legs zung du 'brel ba rnyed pa ni// phyi ma'i dus kyi lung bstan yin par zung*// zhes gsungs pa/ rgyal ba gong ma gnyis/ chos dbyings ind+ra nī lar ro gcig kyang*// dpon slob lhan cig bzhugs par ma gyur pas// re zhig zung du 'brel ba ltar ma gyur// phyi dus karma pa yi zhabs drung du// gus pa chen pos rtag tu bsnyen pa 'di// deng sang rnam pa tha dad bzhugs gyur kyang*// ma 'ongs lhan cig zung 'brel bzhugs la dgongs// zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/ rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs pad nye bar bsnyen te dpon slob lhan cig rnam thos rir phebs/ byi ba lo gsar smon lam rgyas par mdzad/ de tshe rje'i zhal nas/ sprul pa'i sku thub pa chu lon ma gar snang gsungs par/ 'di lags gsungs nas sku brnyan ches mang ba'i nang nas de nyid la phyag 'dzub gtad pa sogs/ de lta'i mdzad tshul gsung gsong por cir yang chags thogs med pa kun yid ches pa'i ltas mtshan ngo mtshar ba ni bgrang las 'das so//

dgung lo bzhi pa la kā ri ka lnga bcu pa/ zab mo nang don gzhung*/ sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug gi gzhung rnams thugs la bzung bas tshegs med du zin pa dang*/ yi ge bri klog kyang rang shugs kyis mkhyen pa byung*/ nyin gcig shar phyogs kyi nam mkhar gzigs nas/ 'jam dbyangs dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ shākya thub pa dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ nor bu/ 'khor lo/ bum pa/ padma/ lhung bzed la sogs pa bkra shis kyi rdzas mang po dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku mang po gzigs 'dug gsungs pa sogs dag pa'i sku dang zhing khams kyi gzigs snang 'gag med du shar zhing*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mos pa gting tshugs pas rje'i mtshan nas brjod cing gsol ba yang yang du 'debs pa dang*/ ring nas byang chub chen po'i spyod pa la goms pas sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa'i 'gro la lhag par yang thugs brtse zhing rtag tu byams brtse'i ngang tshul du bzhugs pa/ 'phral gyi kun tu spyod pa yang bslab pa zhi zhing dul ba la ring du goms pa'i tshul sogs legs pa'i yon tan du ma mngon du gsal la/ dgung lo bdun pa la rtse lha sgang du dge slong 'jam bu la/ karma pa la gsol ba thob/ /karma pa la gsol btab na/ /karma pa yi byin rlabs 'jug /zhes sogs nas/ ma bcos pa la lhod kyis glod/ /zhes pa'i bar zhal gdams shloka du ma gsungs/

dgung lo brgyad pa la rje'i drung du yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan dkon mchog 'bangs su gsol zhing zhwa dmar gyi cod pan yang gnang*/ rim pas smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi byang sdom bzhes pa dang*/ ne gu chos drug la sogs pa'i khrid lung dang man ngag kha 'thor mang po dang lhag par nā ro chos drug la nyams khrid du byas pa nas bzung*/ nyams len gyi sna cung zad zin pas mthong nyams sogs bde stong gi rnal 'byor ci yang shar/ zhes dang*/ kyai rdo rje/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ mai tri bcu gsum ma/ lnga tshan lnga/ nag rgyal phag gsum/ ma hā mā ya/ gdan bzhi/ 'dus pa mi bskyod pa/ gnyis med rnam rgyal/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i dbang bskur dang*/ gdams ngag zab rgyas mang du gsan tshe/ rje karma pa/ 'od phung dang*/ yig 'bru dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ he ru ka dngos sogs su gzigs pa'i gzigs snang ci rigs pa shar ba'i stobs las mi ldog pa'i mos pa 'khrungs pas/ ci 'di las gzhan du shāka thub kyang mi bzhugs snyam du dgongs pas/ lus ngag yid gsum ltos med du phul/ ma rgan sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bdag rang gis 'god pa'i dngos grub zhus nas/ gzhan tshe 'di'i re ltos khas drags che btsan ngan 'gro'i 'babs stegs su gzhol ba'i grags snyan du sgrogs pa de ni rmi lam du yang mi yong ba'i rten 'brel ci 'grig byas shes rnam thar tshig lhug mar gsung zhing*/ yang rje bla ma mi bskyod rgyal bas 'bri khung chos rje dang mnyam du/ dam chos dgongs gcig gnang*/ bya lor rje'i zhal snga nas/ khra ba kha'i ri khrod du dben par bzhugs pa na/ 'bri khung rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba sogs dam pa 'ga' zhig gi sdeb tu rngog dkyil bdun gyi dbang bka' sogs zab chos du ma gsan/ slar sgar du rje rgyal ba'i dbang pos sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i dngul sku'i rab gnas mdzad tshe skal ldan gyi sgrub pa ba 'ga' shas dang lhan cig rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa dang byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma ngo mtshar ba'i dag snang du ma gzigs shing*/

de nas rim gyis ra sgreng dang*/ stag lung gi gnas mjal mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la mtshur phur phebs te/ de dag gi tshe sngon gyi dge bshes chen po gtsug lag khang skyong ba rnams dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pa bla lhag tu skyes/ las 'bras la nges shes gting tshugs/ gong ma'i rnam thar mthong bas/ da cis kyang chos rang dgos pa 'dug /chos byed pa la tshe 'di blos gtong dgos par 'dug /de la yang nga'i bka' brgyud gong ma 'dra ba zhig dgos par 'dug snyam pa bzod med du shar/ de shar bas gangs ri g.ya' ri spang ri lta bu mthong dus mi bzod par 'di 'dra zhig na grogs su yang med par 'chi thub pa zhig byed dgos bsam pa'-i blo snying gas pa tsam skye ba bstar chags byung zhes rnam thar tshig lhug mar gsungs/ dgun der mtshur phur bzhugs/ khyi lo'i sos ka smyug lar rje gtsug lag phreng ba la/ rdo rje phreng ba/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis/ mi tra brgya rtsa sogs dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang dang rjes gnang spyi bka' du ma gsan/ yol gyi yang dben theg chen rtser rje thams cad mkhyen pas mkhan po dang*/ rje phrin las zhabs kyis las slob rje dpa' bos dus bsgo mdzad de/ dgung lo bcu bzhi pa la dge tshul gyi bslab pa bzhes/ slar mtshur phu'i skungs su rje'i drung du dben pa la bzhugs pas bka' chos gdams ngag zab khrid mang du thob pas thugs dam cher 'phel zhing rje la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mdzad/ phag lo'i dbyar gtsang du lo tsā ba kun dga' chos bzang la sgra dang snyan dngags gsan pa'ang mdzad cing*/ ngur smrig byams chen zha lu sogs gnas mjal mdzad/ lhan cig spel rom sogs su bzhugs par yangs can nas phyag mdzod bkra shis dar rgyas sogs yab sras drung du byon nas/ lhan rgyas bde chen yangs pa can gyi chos grwa chen por spyan drangs/ sngon spyan snga rin po che'i chos kyi khrir zhabs zung bkod nas rje rgyal ba'i dbang pos mnga' gsol shis brjod mdzad/

slar yab sras lhan cig tu lho ngos su mos 'dun gyi ngor stod smad thams cad du zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ sras mkhar dgyes rdor pho brang dang gro bo lung sogs kyi gnas mjal mdzad/ ha bo'i gangs zhol kha ror bzhugs skabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung nas bka' chos ches 'phel bar mdzad cing*/ rje dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i drung du/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal rin po che'i lung gi dbu tshugs/ de nas stag lo'i so sos smyug la ba dpon blon gyis gdan drangs te/ chu bzang lung tsha rag phur zhabs chags pa na mngal dang bshol rtsis pa'i dgung lo nyi shu tshang ba'i dbang du mdzad de/ rje rgyal dbang mi bskyod zhabs nyid mkhan po dang las slob dpal gtsug lag phreng ba/ gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon tshogs dge 'dun sgang gi gnas brtan sdom brtson shākya rgya mtsho ba rnams kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun mtshan nyid dang ldan pa grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad cing*/ dpal dkon mchog shākya mchog gi gtso bo'i 'bangs rab tu tshes pa/ zhes mtshan yang gsol te/ de ltar rang gzhan gyi don du mchog sgrub pa'i thabs gtso bo ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gus pas yun du bsten zhing*/ de las gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa ji lta bar legs par nod nas/ tshul bzhin nyams su len pas thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab bskyed pa nyid yin pa'i rnam par thar pa kun nas dkar ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po dag rjes su 'doms rig pa'i phyir/ dgung lo gnyis pa'i ngo mthong nas rje rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gtso bor 'bral med du bsten pa las/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du ma'i smin byed dbang bzhi'i rim pa sogs gong smos sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin dang*/ phyag chen sbyor drug blo sbyong lam rim la sogs pa'i khrid dang bshad lung mang du gsan zhing*/ rje gtsug lag phreng ba'i drung du yang sngar smos las brtsams pa'i dbang khrid man ngag bshad lung gi bka' drin rgya cher nod par mdzad de/

gsan bsam sgom pa'i rnal 'byor la gcig tu 'bad pa'i tshul bstan pas/ dkon mchog 'gro ba'i mgon por legs grub cing*// yan lag 'bum sde'i chos sgo dbye ba la// mi 'jigs spobs pa brnyes pa chos kyi rje// dkon mchog yan lag sku tshe brtan gyur cig/ ces dpal rigs kyi bdag po nyid kyis bstod cing bsngags par mdzad pa ltar gyur la der drung phyag mdzod pa sku mched sogs sngon gyi grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul zhing gsol ba btab bzhin/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung nas kyang de'i dus la bab par dgongs pas bkas gnang ste/ drung nas bkra shis dar rgyas pas 'phral gyi phyags phyi khur len zhus nas stag lo'i dbyar tshar ga bzhugs sgar nas kong por zhabs bteg pa na rje rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid sgar tshugs gcig gi bar zhabs skyel du phebs te 'phral yun gyi bslab bya dang*/ zhal bkod gting phyin pa gnang nas dpon slob 'bral mi phod pa ltar mdzad cing*/ rgyal tshab sprul sku rin po ches bsil sna'i bar phyags skyel mdzad/ de nas 'bri khung nas nyang long brgyud gdan sa dga' ldan ma mor phebs te/ der rje'i bka' bzhin mkhas pa'i dbang po rnam rgyal grags pa klog pa'i slob dpon du bsten nas sde snod kyi gsan pa rgya cher mdzad cing*/ dad ldan skye bo gus pas tshogs pa rnams la so so'i dbang skal dang 'tshams pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin ci rigs par stsal bas 'gro ba de dag mchog gi sa bon grung pos thebs par mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la dpal gyi tsā ri tra gsar ma'i gnas rnams su phebs te rin phug tu bzhugs pa na rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi gnad gsang zab mo du ma zhig thugs la 'khrungs shing*/ de yang rtsa gsum rgya mtshos dgongs pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i nges pa las brtsams te/ yum don mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel rje mi bskyod zhabs nyid kyi dgongs pa dang mthun par 'phags yul gyi thal rang slob dpon phal mo ches rnam rdzun dang bod 'dir gzhan stong dbu mar grags pa'i lugs su bkral ba dang*/

rje rang byung rdo rje'i zab mo nang don gyi 'grel pa dang*/ rje dpa' bo mtsho dkar nas 'bad pas spyan drangs te rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi ljags lung 'phro rdzogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang dbang khrid rnam bshad kyi rim pa du ma gsan/ de tshe rje gong ma'i rnam thar la thugs mos 'phel bas rjes su slob par bzhed pa dang*/ rnam g.yeng gi 'du 'dzi las byol slad gnas der dben pa yun ring bsten pa'i thugs 'dun shar rung*/ dad can sogs du ma'i zhu ngo ma bzlog pas/ slar kong ljongs kun tu phebs te dam pa'i chos kyi phrin las sha stag mdzad pa na/ ris su ma chad pa'i/ sa dkar dge gsum rnying ma tshal 'brug sogs so so'i bla ma dang dge 'dun kun gyis gus pas btud cing*/ dgon gnas so sor spyan drangs pa la gang 'tshams par dam chos kyi bka' drin stsal/ yul gyi skye bo mtha' dag la dge bskul dang gangs can lha gcig spyan ras gzigs kyi chos 'brel sogs stsal nas thar pa'i sa bon rgyud du mdzad/ rje'i drung nas phyags phyir sgar gyi yang ri dang bsgrigs sogs mtshungs pa'i spong pa pa'i sde zhig tshugs gsungs pa'i bka' bzhin dge 'dun lcog grwa'i sde 'dzugs pa mdzad/ nyang po khe nang gi dben pa zhig tu thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi smyung gnas mang du mdzad/ lhag lha la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par gyur te/ bstod pa yang mdzad/ brag phyir bzhugs skabs rim gro pa dbon tshe brtan bzang po dang*/ yum drung zhing gzhan du gshegs shing*/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du yum dang sku mched sogs pha rol du gshegs pa rnams thugs rjes skyobs dgos pa'i zhu ngag dang*/ kye ma kyi hud 'jig rten tshe 'di la/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /zhes sogs kyi gsol 'debs mdzad cing*/ yum gyi don du dga' ldan ma mor gser zangs las grub pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan mi tshad du longs pa rin po che'i phra tshom gyis spras pa bzhengs pa la sogs pa'i dge tshogs rgya cher bsgrub pa gnang*/

rje rgyal ba'i dbang po sku gsung thugs kyi rten ngo mtshar can kho nar thugs spro mnga' bas/ rje dpon gshegs pa'i bsngo zhus su/ thub dbang zangs thang mar grags pa'i rten khyad can de phul ba rje'i drung rin po cher 'byor 'phral/ 'du khang du mchod bkod rgya chen bcas bshams pa'i drung du gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun rnams zhag 'ga' dang 'gar smon lam 'dzugs pa sogs gus mchod dang dgyes pa dpag med mdzad nas/ gandho la'i rten khrod du bzhugs su gsol/ de nas ring po ma lon par rje'i drung nas sgar duu zhabs phyir phebs dgos pa'i bka' shog rim byon bzhin/ 'bul nod rgya cher bcas zhabs drung du phebs par dgongs pas dad 'bul gyi dngos bdog ji snyed 'byor ba phyag bzhes dang*/ gtam gleng du nub gcig rje thams cad mkhyen pa zhing gzhan gshegs pa'i rmang lam mngon sum ltar gsal ba zhig byung ba las sad 'phral dbu sngas spyan chab kyis brlan nas 'dug pa la thugs skyo ba'i gdung shugs drag po skyes te/ yar phebs/ dga' ldan ma mo'i mdzod kyi bzang dgu'i dngos po yang bdog par mdzad nas/ gzhi ba rnams la/ gdul bya'i pad tshal kun nas rgyas mdzad pa'i// bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' yis bskul ba'i phyir// kho bo 'di nas bla ma'i drung du 'gro/ zhes sogs nas/ nga la bsam na dam pa'i chos la 'bungs// 'jig rten 'khor ba'i shal thag gcod par zhu// yon mchod thams cad sku khams ci bder bzhugs// zhes pa'i bar gyi zhal gdams gnang ste/ dwags po'i gzhung sogs brgyud/ lcags khyi zla ba brgyad pa'i yar ngo'i tshe/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgar chen 'dus sde dang bcas byar dwags mtshams lha khang skye skyes dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su dbyar gnas su bzhugs pa'i sar phebs pa na/ gu'i gung pa dang nang so ba sogs drung 'khor rnams kyis chibs bsu dang thab 'dzin dge 'dun rnams kyis dar cha 'phan gdugs/

spos dang rol mo'i bye brag sogs bkod pa mtha' yas pa'i ser sbreng gi bsu ba dang bcas gzim gur du yab sras khri 'phangs mnyam par bshams pa sogs dgyes bkur bla lhag tu mdzad cing*/ rje sprul pa'i sku'i zhal snga nas kyang tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil thang spras thags las grub pa 'dom 'khor gyi tshad tsam dang*/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas dung dkar g.yas 'khyil che legs kyis gtsos dngos bdog c-i mchis pa thams cad rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan sngar bstar te phul ba sogs 'phags pa chos 'phags la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus bsnyen bkur ba bzhin/ gus pa dang bkur sti bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ de nas zhag 'ga'i bar gandho la sogs kyi rten mchod khyad can dang*/ phyag rdzas khyad can rnams gzigs mo'i tshul du rje sprul pa'i sku'i spyan sngar 'bebs pa dang*/ nyin gcig chibs pa chos rje dang*/ drung lo tsā ba kun dga' chos bzang sogs grwa pa bdun dang bcas sna len gyi gnang skyes gya nom pa'ang stsal te/ mjal phrad skabs bzhugs khri khyad med du bshams pa la sogs pa 'di kun gdan sa'i rten 'brel dang*/ don gyis phyag rdzas sogs rtsis 'bul mdzad pa yin par rje dpa' bo gsungs/ de nas sngon bzhin zhabs phyir bsnyen te yar stod du phebs/ rnam rgyal sgang du mkhas pa chen po chos rje sangs bkras pa dang*/ sde snod kyi dri ba dris lan mang du mdzad cing*/ dga' tshal du rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'du khang du 'jigs byed kyi tshogs dbu dang*/ sprul pa'i sku gtsang khang steng du bde mchog tshogs dbu mdzad nas gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rab gnas mdzad/ slar dwags por phebs te bshad sgrub gling du lo gsar smon lam dang rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor mang po zhal phye ba'i sgrub mchod gar dang bcas pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje'i bka' bzhin dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje slob dpon du bzhugs te/

gar gyi phur gdab dang*/ sbyin sreg sogs bcas mdzad/ cho ga grol nyin rdul tshon chu klung du spyan 'dren par phebs pa na/ skor lam shar gyi rdo ba gtan zug zhig la zhabs rjes ches gsal ba byon/ de tshe rgyal ba mi bskyod zhabs kyi zhal snga nas/ rje zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas skyes bu mchog gi mtshan nyid la legs par sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa'i stobs dang*/ sku skye ba 'di nyid du'ang 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa gzhan la 'doms pa'i ched du dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten cing dam pa'i chos rnal mar sku nyams su bstar ba'i ngang tshul gsal por snang ba la shin tu dgyes pa'i thugs kyis rjes su yi rang bar mdzad pa dang*/ skye bo gang zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang don du gnyer ba dag kyang 'di ltar slobs shig ces rjes su gdams pa'i slad du gang gi rnam par thar pa la don dang mthun par bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ sprul pa'i sku mchog zhwa dmar ba la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dud pas bstod do//

tshe 'dir bdag nyid snyan dang grags sogs phyir// chos dang 'jig rten phun tshogs gzhan kun las// 'gran zla bral ba'i bsam sbyor mi 'dzin pa'i// sprul sku dkon mchog yan lag zhabs la 'dud// zhes sogs nas/ bla med byang chub chen po thob phyir bsngo/ /ces pa'i bar gyi tshigs su bcad pa mang pos don gyi rnam thar la bstod pa'i gsol 'debs kyang stsal/ de nas gsang sngags gling du phebs te bzhugs par/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar rjes 'jug 'dul bya'i nyams len yin phyir 'dir chos 'chad pa la gleng gzhi dang gleng slong gnyis yin gsungs/ gleng gzhi ni dngos po'i gnas lugs de yin gsungs/ de la brten nas brjod pa ni gleng slong yin gsungs pa sogs las 'phros pa'i zin bris kyang mdzad/ de'i tshe karma pa dbus dwags kyi dus gzings byung ba'i chings la phebs shing*/ rje sprul pa'i sku chos sde dang bcas dwags por bzhugs te/ chos kyis 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ rje rin po ches dus gzings zhi 'jags mdzad nas gdan sa thel du lhan cig phebs/ dpon sa spyan sngas mjal 'phrad dang phyi nang rten mjal sogs zhib mor mdzad/ de nas lhan cig yar rgyab dpon chen pas spyan drangs nas/ zan yangs lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i rten rnams kyi drung du mchod 'bul dang smon lam rgya cher mdzad cing byams gling du bzhugs/ der tshogs dge 'dun sgang gi mkhan chen sogs rnams kyis gus pas mjal 'phrad mdzad skabs/ gzim chung du zhal ba mdog 'gyur ba'i zhabs rjes rlan sogs rkyen gzhan gyis mi 'jigs pa zhig byon pa rab 'byams pa rdor bzang pa la rdo bas brang la med par gyis gsungs bzhin med par byas shing*/ phyis yangs can gyi gzim chung rin chen bkod du yang zhabs rjes de lta bu gcig byon pa ches gsal por bzhugs/ de nyid kyi yang dben du yab sras sku mtshams bzhugs skabs rje nyid las rdor phreng chag lugs dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'i dbang rdzogs par rje karma pas gsan tshul bstan/

de yang sprul pa'i sku phyi ma'i yongs 'dzin rtsod med du mnga' gsol bar gleng*/ de nas lhan rgyas dpon sa gong ma chen po'i sa la spyod pa'i dpal 'byor chen pos mdun bsus nas mthong sa klu sdings su gdan chags/ spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa la bsnyen bkur ba'i srol rnams ji lta ba bzhin bsti stang dang ri mor byas shing chos 'brel rgya cher zhus/ sa skyong hor bsod nams dar rgyas pas 'phyong rgyas su spyan drangs/ srong btsan klu sdings su gdan phab pa na/ byang nas dge slong dgon pa ba bzod bzang mched grogs yab sras mjal du byon pas/ zhal gdams zhus pa la/ kho bo chung nas khyed cag gnyis dang 'phrad/ /zhes sogs nas/ sgro 'dogs nang nas chod par gdon mi za/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis sngar byas kyi sgrub pa la yi rang dang thugs kyi nying khu byung ba'i zhal gdams gnang zhing dgyes pa dpag med mdzad/ de dag gi tshe rgya gar nas bram ze'i rigs las tshangs par spyod pa sa n+ya shrī kā shi bhārthi zhes pa bod du 'ong nas zhabs phyir bsdad pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad de de'i tshul shes par 'dod pa la rnam grangs gsal bar byed pa nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs stsal zhing*/ phyis mtsho dkar du/ 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa dag dang bcas pa'i phyir// dbang phyug che dang khyab 'jug la sogs pa// skyabs su mi bya btang snyoms su bzhag nas// bcom ldan 'das dang de sras spyan ras gzigs// de dang gnyis su med pa'i karma pa// de yi sras po dkon mchog 'bangs sogs la// skyabs su mchi zhing gsol ba 'debs lags pas// tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin du gsol// kā shi bhārthi thugs rjes bzung du gsol// zhes pa'i gsol 'debs kyang stsal te yang dag pa'i lam la gzud par mdzad/ dbus su bzhugs skabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' ltar thang chen chos rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhig bzhugs pa la chag lo gong 'og nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' 'ga' shas kyang gsan/

stabs gcig yar stod du phebs te/ lhun sgang du rje'i drung nas rten gtor 'dzugs pa gnang skabs/ bka' bzhin sbyin sreg gi phyag bzhes mdzad/ slar tsā ri mtsho dkar du phebs te bzhugs/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ dbang rjes gnang khrid ka mang du gsan zhing*/ der rje'i zhal nas/ so so'i skye bo'i bla ma des dam pa'i chos ston pa de yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i mthu yin pas/ zhes sogs kyi zhal gdams gnang ba'i gsung zin bris kyang mdzad/ de gong bshad sgrub gling du bzhugs dus zhig na/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa des gdul bya phyi ma la dgongs pa'i zhal ta mang du byon bzhin/ mtsho dkar du phebs nas ring por ma lon par gzhan ngor sku khams mnyel pa'i tshul bstan zhing*/ zhing khams brje ba'i rnam 'gyur mang du mdzad pa dang*/ rje sprul pa'i sku nyid la'ang*/ tshe 'di blos thong*/ bya bral gyis/ zang zing 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med pas/ sgrub brgyud kyi rnam par thar pa'i phyir snyogs shig zhes sogs kyi zhal bkong mang du stsal/ dus der dwags kong dus 'khrugs ldang bar chings lugs la rje nyid sku 'khor bcas phebs dgos shar zhing*/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa sku khams mnyel ba'i tshul bstan bzhin stag lo'i dbyar gnas mtsho dkar du mdzad/ de nas sku rab dang bshad sgrub gling sogs brgyud de/ yar stod sham po'i gangs zhol ra mor khrums zla'i nyer gsum la sprul pa'i rol gzugs chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan/ der spyan 'dren du gu'i gung pa nang so ba lhags ltar mgyogs myur gyis sgar du phebs nas gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshang ma gdan sa chen po mtshur phur gdan phab ste/ sgar dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa kun la rje'i sprul sku myur 'byon/ g.yo med rdo rje 'dzin dang ḍā ki ma/ /sogs kyi gsol 'debs 'dzugs pa mdzad/

lho brag nas rje dpa' bo dpon slob kyang phebs te sku gdung rin po che tsan dan dkar dmar/ a ga ru 'ba' zhig gi zhugs la bzhen pa dang*/ mtshur gnas nang yangs can yang zur lcog grwa sngags grwa sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun du mas mchod 'bul gyi cho ga mang du 'dzugs pa/ lha sar jo bo shākya mu ni'i drung du gser zho sum brgya las bskrun pa'i maṇḍal dang*/ 'phags yul ma ga dha rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo dhi la snyan dar dang mchod 'bul gyi rgyun thes su gser mang zhig sogs rgya bod yongs kyi rten khyad can kun la snyan dar dang mchod pa/ sa skya dang thel 'bri stag dge 'bras sogs kyis gtsos mnga' ris nas dwags kong yan gyi dgon sde grub pa'i mtha' ris su ma chad pa yongs la mang ja 'gyed chen/ bla slob kun la mchod bsngo'i rten gyi 'bul nod rnam gzhag dang bcas pa rgya cher stsal zhing*/ kar sde rnams la de thog dad rten gyi skal pa dang*/ gdan sa gong 'og bar gsum gyi zhal ngo'i gtsos khams bod kyi mi chen rje nyid kyi zhabs la thugs pa kun la'ang gdung skal dang gnang cha gya nom pa gnang ste sngon rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi deb mtshur phur 'dug pa dang*/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i dgongs rdzogs deb sogs kyi dbang du byas na de dag las kyang ches rmad du byung ba gnang zhes 'byung*/ de nas rje dpa' bo rin po che'i zhal snga nas sogs nas/ sngon rje de nyid nas bzhugs khri khyad med mdzad cing phyag rdzas rnams kyang gzigs 'bul gyi tshul gyis phal cher rtsis sprod gnang grub ltar dang*/ bshad sgrub gling du sgar pa rnams la nged re zhig 'gol ba cig byed pa yin pas khyed rang sgar pa'i skyabs gnas sprul pa'i sku thams cad mkhyen pa la zhus/ ces snga phyir bka' stsal/ gnang ba gong du rgyal tshab tu bskos zin par 'dug pa'i dgongs pa sgrub dgos shes/

sgar phyi nang dang mtshur rtse sgang 'bri gdan rin spung sogs bu slob grwa ris sbyin bdag 'gongs che ba kun la bka' gros bskor ba mdzad nas/ thams cad kyis gsol btab bzhin/ gdan sa dpal gyi mtshur phu'i bla g.ye chen mor gur chen bzhugs khri yol sgor sogs bkod shoms rgya chen mdzad de/ rje sprul pa'i sku rin po che nyid rgyal tshab bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol te/ bod chen ljongs kyi srid gnyis spyod pa ba skyabs rol mchog dman kun yid la ngal gso thob pa'i legs ja'i 'bul nod rgya cher bgyis shing*/ gdan sa mtshur phur rje'i sku gdung dang sku bal gyi ring bsrel gyi mchod rten sogs bzhugs pa'i ched du btsug lag khang bkra shis gsar mar zhig gsos dang*/ thugs rten du dngul srang chen bzhi stong brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ gser zho brgyad brgya go bzhi sogs las grub pa'i dpal lha bab mchod rten mtho sum cu pa bang rim gyi ngos la rje nyid kyi rnam thar mdzad pa'i rnam grangs brgya rtsa brgyad du bsgrigs pa'i bkod pa rin po che rin thang bral ba sna tshogs kyi phra rgyan gyis spras pa/ bzo dang nang don rig pa la lhan skyes kyi spobs pa dge ba can karma srid bral bas bzo bkod do dam gyis yos lo zla ba bzhi pa'i yar tshes la bzo 'go 'dzugs pa mdzad/ gsung gi rten du mdo sngags kyi bka'i dgongs 'grel rje de nyid kyis rang gzhung dang*/ gzhan 'grel du mdzad pa'i bstan bcos ji snyed pa rnams/ oṃ siddhirastu/ gcig tu zhi ba'ang bde chen sbyor bzhed na/ /zhes sogs kyi dkar chag tu btab pas bka' bsdu mdzad pa bzhin/ nor can sku rab chos mdzad mas rgyu rkyen gyi nyer len kyang bgyis te/ gser rkyang gis bka' 'bum pusti sum cu/ sku rten rje nyid kyi sku brnyan dngul gdung gi bum sku gdung thal rus las grub pa dang*/ gzim mal sku 'dra gser las grub pa jo tshad du nye ba tsam rnams rim pas bzhengs su gsol bar mdzad cing*/

rje nyid rin po che phal cher mtshur phu dang yangs can du bzhugs te/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams la tshogs chos dang*/ so sor zab khrid kyi rim pa sogs gang 'tshams pa'i bka' drin stsal/ de dag skabs/ bzhag bla bsod lhun pa sogs kyis khams 'gros mdzad khar sprul pa'i sku gang du 'byon zhus pa la/ phal cher sngon rje nyid kong por bzhugs skabs kyi gsung mgur na yod pa'i/ nga skye ba 'di yi 'og rol du// kre shod gangs kyi ra ba'i stod// zhes sogs su rang 'byon nam gsungs pa bzhin phyis de kho na ltar gyur/ mtshur phu grwa tshang gi slaub dpon du drung nas sangs dang la ba dang*/ gnas nang nang sor dka' bcu ba dpal ldan bzang bsko ba/ rgyud grwa'i slob dpon du sngags ram pa tshul khrims rnam rgyal bsko bzhag dang*/ chu shul bar gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i zhal ta gnang ba/ rab 'byams pa karma rnam rgyal legs bshad gling gi gdan sar bskos shing*/ gtsang khang gi rje byams pa'i sku bzhengs 'phro'i zhib tshags gzungs bzhugs rab gnas rnams grub par mdzad tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char yang byung*/ sngags grwa karma rig 'dzin mkha' spyod gling pa'i slob dpon sngags ram pa kun spang zhus pa'i gdan sar rab 'byams pa kar bstan rgya mtsho bsko bzhag mdzad nas yar rgyab tu zhal ngo rnams la bslab ston dang bcas/ sgrags rgyal byed tshal gyi dgon gnas chos gzhis dang bcas te sbyor ba/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gling du li dmar las grub pa'i ston pa'i sku khyad can gser dngul gyi khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa gnang ba/ thob rgyal 'dul grwa gling du slob dpon kun spangs bgyis pa'i gdan sar rab 'byams smra ba zhal ta pa bsko ba/ dga' tshal karma gzhung lugs gling du mkhan dbang rnam rgyal pas kun spangs zhus pa'i bzhugs gnas dwags po'i yom dgon pa 'bul ba mdzad nas/ gdan sar mi nyag bka' bcu pa bskos shing*/

de rnams la phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan gyi rtsa ba sdom pa gsum la tshul bzhin du slob dgos tshul sogs kyi bca' yig dang zhal gdams rgyas par gnang*/ mchod yon spyi dgos kyi dge legs su lhun sgang du rten gtor 'dzugs pa yang mdzad/ zhal ngo rnams rtse gcig dad pas nā ro chos drug la sogs pa'i zab chos kyi bka' drin zhus shing*/ dzhaikṣim las grub pa'i thub dbang sku rdo rje gdan chung ma khyad can dang bsam grub bde chen pa'i bla g.yu seng ge zho spungs kyis thogs drangs pa'i 'bul bsnyen rgya cher zhus/ gzhan yang zur ru gdong gi gdan sar bka' bcu karma rgya mtsho bsko ba/ bshad sgrub gling du dge slong kun rin pa bskos nas/ gtsug lag khang gi logs bris shing rtsi lha chen bzhengs 'phro sogs tshags su bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen dang zhal bskos mdzad pa sogs chos sde so so'i bla ma slob dpon dgos pa rnams bsko ba/ dge rgyun gyi chos gzhis dang cha rkyen sbyor ba/ grwa pa gsar bu pa rnams la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs 'phral dus su gnang ba/ re zhig legs bshad gling du dge 'dun rnams la dpal lhan cig skyes ma'i bskyed rim lha khrid kyi gdams pa stsol zhing bzhugs pa'i nyin cig sus smras kyi nges pa med par mchog sprul 'khrungs yod 'dug zer ba'i skad ngag dang*/ dge 'dun gyi mang ja'i tshogs dung grags pa lhan cig tu byung bas/ rten 'brel bzang snyam du dgongs pa'i thugs spro rgya cher 'khrungs te/ bla ma rgyal mtshan sogs dge slong sum sbrel zhig la/ bkra shis kha btags dang*/ rje'i gsol thur bskur te mchog sprul gang du 'khrungs lta nyul dang nye len la mngags pa mdzad/ der sngon rje'i bka' ltar kun rig rnam grol sgo chen gyi chog bsgrigs mdzad nas par du bsgrub pa dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu'i cho ga nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gtor dbang dang*/

thig rtsa lho sgo'i lhan thabs dang bcas pa/ mgon po'i las byang 'khor lnga las 'grigs gsol kha sogs dag ther dang par du bsgrub par mdzad/ yar klungs su sde srid zhal ngo nang khul gyi chings lugs la phebs nas pho brang sne'u gdong rtser bzhugs pa'i nub gcig tho rengs kyi rmang lam du/ rin chen khri steng mtshungs med sprul pa'i sku/ / zhes sogs rje nyid kyis stsal ba'i rnam thar du gsung bzhin/ mchog sprul bsam bzhin du srid pa nye bar bzhes shing*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman mchog tu 'gyur ba'i mtshan ltas gsal por yang gzigs/ de nas mtshur phu'i dben gnas khyung rdzong gi sgrub khang bcos skyar mdzad pa der bzhugs pa na/ sbrul lo zla ba bzhi par si tu rin po ches sngon gyi lung bstan bzhin kre smad stag bzang du mchog sprul 'brug lo la bltams pa'i gtam snyan 'bul mi gnang ba 'byor bas/ rol mo dang ri klung kun du dar 'phyar ba la sogs pa'i dga' ston rgya cher mdzad cing*/ thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa chen po/ /zhes sogs kyi sprul pa'i sku'i brtan bzhugs dang*/ gzim skyil du sku rim du sgrol dkar cho ga rgyun chags su 'dzugs pa gnang*/ dbus gtsang gi grwa rigs sbyin bdag rnams la yang bka' 'phros stsal/ zla ba drug par ja 'dren thog ma 'bul bar/ rje gong ma'i sku'i rim gro bla sman pa sogs dge slong bcu phrag tsam zhig tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu yongs smin pas/ /zhes sogs kyi zhu 'phrin dang bcas te/ 'phral gyi na bza' dang dbu zhwa zhwa nag rgyun bzhes/ gsol spyad/ phyag tham/ gzhon nu'i rol tshul dang 'tshams pa'i gos chas rgyan sogs nyer mkho 'bul ba dang zham ring du rdzong ba gnang zhing*/ gong du 'jang rgyal po bad dkar 'dzin rgyal sar 'khod pa'i dga' ston legs skyes 'bul skyel gyi mgron tshan la/ mchog sprul sku bltams pa'i snyan sgrogs kyi gtam skyes dang*/

rgyal po nyid rgyal sar 'khod pa'i shis brjod dang bslab bya'i chab shog legs ja'i rten 'byung du/ bkra shis kha btags/ srab chen kunda'i me tog ltar dkar ba/ bye ru dkar po zla ba'i thig le lta bu bcas rnams stsal/

lo de nyid kyi zla ba bcu gnyis pa la dngul gdung rin po che rten dang brten bcas legs par grub par/ rje dpa' bo dang zhal rgyas rdo rje slob dpon du phebs te/ rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor chen po du ma zhal phye nas rab tu gnas pa legs par mdzad de/ rab gnas tshugs pa nas rlung 'tshubs zhi zhing drod cher bab pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i nyin byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma ches mang du byung zhing*/ bzo sbyong pa rnams la gser sil ma zho bdun brgya lhag tsam gyis gtsos pa'i yon rdzongs dang*/ 'go lung do dam pa kun la'ang rnam gzhag gi gnang cha rgya cher stsal zhing tshim par mdzad cing*/ gsar ma shod du dngul gdung rin po cher dkar bum pho brang ma che legs cha dang*/ dngul gyi maṇḍal gsar bzos dang*/ sngon rje nyid la gong ma cing de'i pho nya tha'i kyen gyis phul ba'i dngul spyad khyad mtshar ba 'ga' zhig gis thog drangs pa'i gser spyad dngul spyad shel spyad dkar spyad/ 'phan gdugs bla bres snyan dar sogs kyi mchod rdzas dang*/ sgo pas sbyin bdag zhus pa'i mchod me'i sbra kha sogs mchod pa rgyun chags kyi cha rkyen dpag med sbyor ba dang*/ sku tshab gzim mal gyi sku brnyan bla ma lha khang du drung na rim gong ma'i sku 'dra rnams kyi grar bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ khri cog gras 'grigs/ 'phan bla bre gsol spyad dbang chas la sogs pa'i mchod shoms kyi bkod legs mdzad/ gsol dpon shāka rdor bas rje'i sku sman 'dams las grub pa sku tshad ma zhig bzhengs pa la rab tu gnas par mdzad de 'bras spungs mchod rten du bzhugs par bkas gnang*/ rta lor dge 'dun yang ri ba rje sprul pa'i sku'i sku rim dang sri zhu la snga 'gros su rdzong ba mdzad/ de dag gi tshe spung ri nang so ba yor bsko ba dang*/ dbon kar bstan kwan ting gu shri'i las ka dang bcas te dga' ldan ma mo'i gdan sar bsko ba/ g.yam bzang gi spyan snga la gu shri'i las ka gnang ba sogs kyang mdzad/

de nas bzhugs sgar kyang rim pas rje'i mchog sprul spyan 'dren la mdo khams phyogs su 'degs pa'i dgongs pas rje dpa' bo'i drung du phyag 'bul dang smon lam byin rlabs zhu bar lho brag tu phebs te/ khams nas mchog sprul spyan drangs nas slar ma 'byor bar gtsang dbus dwags kong gi bstan pa brtse spyan gyis 'tsho dgos pa la sogs pa'i zhu 'bul mdzad/ rje des kyang mchog sprul dbus su myur bar spyan 'drongs pa mdzad nas mjal thub pa zhig dgos pa'i zhal bkod sogs so so nas thugs dgyes tshim mdzad de/ tshur 'brog stod du phebs par/ rin spungs sa skyong ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug gis spyan 'dren dang*/ sgar gyi thugs dam rten gandho la'i bcas skor rten mjal kyang zhu bzhed pa'i zhu 'phrin dang gser yig 'byor bas mtshur phu nas rten sgam rags rim kyang spyan 'dren mdzad de/ lug lo'i dbyar gtsang phyogs la rong chen brgyud de chibs bsgyur/ bde skyid gling nas sa dbang dpon blon sku 'khor rgya mtsho'i dpal 'byor sum rtsen gyi dbang po sa la spyod pa lta bu'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas mdun bsus te mkha' ru steng klu sdings su gdan phab/ bkur sti dang rim gro dpag tu med pas bsti stang du bgyis shing*/ rten mjal sogs gnang tshe kun gyi mthong snang mthun par kha dog sna lnga'i 'ja' tshon dang me tog gi char bab pa'i ltas mtshan ngo mtshar ba du ma byung*/ g.yung dar rgyas su chos mdzad mas rje'i bka' 'bum bzhengs grub par rab gnas dang gdan sar spyan 'dren du bcug gser mdog nas mkhas dbang dpal mchog pa dang*/ skyed tshal nas chos rje gung pa sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po du ma mjal du byon pa rnams la so so'i thugs mos dang 'tshams pa'i dam chos bka' drin stsal/ bdag mo rgyal rtse mas rdzong dkar du spyan drangs te mchod pa dang bkur sti rgya chen po dang*/

gzhan yang yul gru so so ba 'ga' dang 'ga' zhig nas zhabs pad du gus 'dud kyi 'bul bsnyen ci rigs pa dang*/ chibs bsgyur ba'i lam bar gyi chos sde dang mi sde mchog dman bar mar gyur pa kun gyis spyan 'dren dang 'bul zhabs mchod sprin ni bgrang ba las 'das shing*/ de rnams kyi mkhan slob kyis gtsos pa'i chos sde rnams la'ang gang 'tshams pa'i dam chos kyi bka' drin dang 'phral yun gyi bslab bya dang zhal bsgos mthil phyin stsal zhing*/ yul ris kyi skye bo de dag gi tshogs kyang yang dag pa'i lam la 'god pa'i phrin las rgya cher mdzad cing phebs te/ zab phu lung gi gnas mjal gnang tshe dgun yin yang gter lung gi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kha dog lnga 'phro ba byung*/ snye mo bra skor du rgyal tshab sprul sku grags pa don grub dgung lo bcu gsum pas mjal/ der hor dpon thar pa 'bum 'das pa'i bsngo zhus dang*/ yangs can drung nas spyan 'dren pa 'byor/ chos sde bye mkhar du rje dbon pan chen pas gzhi len gyi zhabs tog dang*/ bshad pa bgro gleng sogs legs par bshad pa'i mchod pas mnyes par mdzad cing*/ rin rtse pas kyang 'bul zhabs yang dag bgyis/ de nas rje dus mkhyen rin po che rlung dhū tir chud pa'i gnas mchog gzhu gru bzhi'i gzim bug sogs kyi gnas mjal mdzad de/ tshes drug la gdan sa yangs can du gdan phab par mdzad/ dga' ldan ma mo nas dbon gu shri kar bstan byon pas rta 'bul gtos che ba bgyis/ lo mjug sku rim dang lcags pho spre'u lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ 'jang rgyal blon mchod yon gyi 'bul skyel sleb/ smon lam gyi thog 'du khang gsar mar gandho la'i rten shom rgyas pa dang*/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun stong dang nye ba la ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs brgya rtsa'i ljags lung gnang*/ de skabs rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku la yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang*/

byang sdom gnang ba bcas mdzad cing*/ dpal ldan grags pa don grub khyab bdag chos kyi nyi ma zhes mtshan yang gsol/ zla ba gnyis par sngon yab sras bshad sgrub gling du bzhugs skabs rje de nyid kyi tshems zhig byon pa rje nyid la gnang ba de'i bzhugs khang dngul gyi mchod rten rkang gang tsam bum nang du tshems nyid dra tshags kyi padma shel kas bteg pa'i rgya phibs dang bcas par bzhugs su gsol nas rab tu gnas par mdzad/ de skabs zur ri bla ma/ rje 'phrin las gnyis pa sogs gnyug mar bzhugs pa'i skyes chen du ma dang*/ dge slong bsam gtan pa dang*/ dbon bzod bzang sogs byang ngos kyi ri dang*/ dgon sder bzhugs pa phal cher kyang 'dus te tshogs pa nyis stong lhag pa la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang yongs rdzogs dang*/ gzhan yang so so'i mos bstun bzhin dbang bka' khrid lung man ngag ci rigs pas tshim par mdzad/ kong po hor sogs kyi 'bul skyel gtos cher 'byor/ kre chung sprul sku la stod lhor 'khrungs pa bu slob rnams kyis spyan drangs nas byung ba'i gtsug phud bzhes shing mtshan karma bslab gsum rgya mtshor gsol/ phyag chen chos drug sogs khrid lung gi rgyun ci rigs pa skabs su stsal zhing*/ stod lung bde chen du phebs nas phun tshogs bkod shod du mgon sku bzhugs pa dang*/ rten gtor 'dzugs pa sogs mdzad de/ mtshur phu dang gnas nang gi rten gsum rnams la khams phyogs chibs bsgyur ba'i phyag 'bul dang*/ sku chas phye bsal la mtshur phur phebs/ thub chen dang dngul gdung rin po ches thog drangs rten gsum rnams la mchod sprin spros shing gus phyag smon lam thugs tshim par mdzad/ dge 'dun zur ri bas rje'i sku gdung thal rus las grub pa'i sku tshad du bzhengs par rab gnas mdzad/ mtshur phu rin po che dang de gong nas nar ma'i cha rkyen bde chen nas yong ba mdzad de gtsug lag khang gi dkon gnyer sgo pa nang so ba bsko ba gnang ba kun la phyi nang gi 'dzin skyong mchod 'bul dang bsgrig bslab so so'i chos srid skyong tshul 'di ltar gyi bka' mchid zhal ta mang du stsal/

ston pa rin po che dang gnas bcu gser zangs las grub pa zung 'jug brgyud rim rnams bla ma lha khang du bzhugs gsol gyi khri'u 'di bzhin gyi zhal bkod rtsis sprod gnang*/ gnas nang du rten gsum la phyag mchod smon lam bcas mdzad nas/ yangs can du phebs/ yangs can mkhan por dge slong cham kha ba dang*/ na lend+ra'i gzim khang 'og gi gdan sar rtse le chos mdzad sogs bsko ba dang*/ dge 'dun legs gling pa sogs dpon slob chos sde so so nas phyag 'bul du byon pa rnams la zhal ta bslab ston rgya cher gnang zhing*/ bshad sgrub gling du lha chen gyi gzungs bzhugs rab gnas su zhar gyi chibs bsgyur zhus par/ de ltar rje dpa' bor zhus gsungs nas byin rten sogs kyi yo byad gang dgos gnang*/ gdan sa bar nas si tu rin po ches spyan 'dren nyer len pa'ang 'byor bas/ spre'u hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu gsum la bkra shis mthong smon du bzhugs sgar skar gnon mdzad/ der ston sgom sogs kyis drung 'khor las dgongs zhu dang*/ rje dpal khang pa dang*/ sgom chen gzhon blo ba sogs gzhi bzhugs phal cher rnams phyag 'bul bgyis/ de nas byang ngos las rim par btegs te/ lha nang gi gnas mjal dang*/ kong dgon du dpon pos spyan drangs nas 'bul zhabs rgya cher dang*/ tshogs pa rnams la dbang chos stsal/ rong po 'dam du chos rje ban sgar ba/ paṇḍi sku mched dang rong po'i dpon chen hu tri sde ma lag dang bcas mchod yon rnams kyis so so nas 'bul mchod rgya cher byas te/ dbang skal dang 'tshams pa'i chos bka' stsal/ phag mo nas gcung dam pa gshegs pa'i bsngo zhus gur chen yol sgor bcas sogs kyis gtsos pa'i 'bul chen sleb/ rje'i bka' slob dpon shar pa dang*/ tsa ngu ba/ stag lung nas dpon sa mchod yon rnams phyag 'bul du byon/ gnam mtsho bkra shis do bo che'i gnas gzigs la phebs/ kun gyis gus mchod dang bcas/

slar 'dam gzhung nas brgyud/ hor stod smad kyi dums mdzad/ der stod lung pa'i phal mi gcig gis rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku li dmar las grub pa khyad par can phul bas rab tu dgyes te/ thugs dam 'bral spang gi rten du bzhugs/ dbon byang snying pas dbu mar spyan drangs nas 'bul zhabs dang tshogs par phag mo'i dbang dang lha khrid stsal/ dge 'dun sngags grwa ba/ g.yam bzang spyan snga/ lha mdongs lo tsā ba rnams phyag 'bul zhus nas yar so sor thegs/ dga' tshal rab 'byams rgyal bzang ba spau bo g.yu ri dgon du bskos/ de nas 'bab rom gnas mjal dang chos rje ka bzhi drug rnams kyis gus 'dud dang rten mjal rnams zhib gzigs phul/ thams cad kyis rim pas 'bul bsnyen dang bcas/ shag chu khar sog zam pa'i spyan 'dren pa 'byor zhing*/ g.yag la se bo'i 'dabs nas 'brong bu gu shri dpon g.yog rnams phebs bsur byon/ phyi nyin dge 'dun gyi ser sbreng sogs bsu bkod bla lhag pas tsan dan dgon du phebs/ sde dgon rnams kyis 'bul zhabs dpag med bgyis shing*/ sog rong sogs brgyud nas/ phag gru'i bu chen yel pa'i gdan sa rta rnar phebs/ de rnams su skal pa dang 'tsham pa'i thabs mkhas thugs rje'i phrin las kyis 'gro rnams phan bder mdzad bzhin/ rim gyis mdo khams mchod rten gyi sar phebs/ der karma nas drung spung ri ba dpon slob phebs bsur byon/ gdan sar phebs nyin thabs su dang ser sbreng la sogs pa bsu bkod ya mtshan par mdzad cing*/ rje nyid nas kyang gtsug lag khang gzigs pa tsam nas dbu zhwa 'bud pa sogs gus 'dun cher mdzad de/ bkra shis gsar mar bzhugs yul gnang nas/ si tu rin po che dang mjal 'phrad dang rten gsum rnams la mchod pa dang*/ phyag 'bul smon lam mdzad/ g.yen mo cher gzhi len gyi sgar ston dang si tu rin po che rang gi gzim chung sngags khang du spyan drangs nas bris 'bur gyi rten gsar rnams la phyag nas zhu ba sogs gus 'dun dang dgyes pa'i gsung bgro zhib par mdzad nas sku chas kha shas kyang 'jog pa mdzad nas/

zur mang du phebs te sde dgon kun gyis 'bul zhabs rgya cher bgyis shing*/ zur mang bya btang ba'i sku skye de nyid kyi dbon rigs su 'khrungs pa chos rje blo gros pa rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs te mtshan karma legs bshad sgra dbyangs su btags/ de nas tsher lung pa'i dgon bdud del sogs las brgyud/ 'bri rgyud a la sdong gruu sor phebs nas lo mjug sku rim/ lcags mo bya lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ khrom tshogs ches mang ba'i bud med gzi mchong gi rgyan btags pa mang pos bla ma ma ṇi par gzi mang du phul ba phyis kre bor phebs tsa dbus nas bsnams pa'i bye ru spos shel dang spel ba'i do shal mdzad nas/ na bza' khra mang sogs dang bcas te/ rje sprul sku'i yum la sku skyos kyi tshul du gnang ba mdzad song*/ de nas rim gyis 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che'i dus kyi gtsug lag khang 'dzing rnam rgyal du phebs/ der kaḥthog chos rje sku mched mjal du byon/ rje mchog sprul zhabs drung nas 'tsho byed shangs dkar ba sogs ja 'dren du gnang ba'ang 'byor/ rim pas phebs/ kre stod stong mo gru sor phebs pa na lcags mo gu shri/ yang ri bla ma/ gnas brtan chen po sogs dpon slob rnams phyag 'bul gdan 'dren la byon/ de nas rje gong mas phyi ma'i gnas lung bstan gyi dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug rang byung kyang mjal ba mdzad de/ rje nyid dgung lo sum cu rtsa bdun pa mchog sprul dgung lo drug bzhes pa bya lo hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes la kre shod lhun rtser phebs te/ de nyid kyi dgon zhol mar khu kong zer ba'i zhing kha zhig tu bzhugs sgar phab nas chibs rags thog ma yang rir phebs pa la rje mchog sprul dpon slob gzim khang steng nas gzigs pa gnang gi 'dug par chibs thog nas dbu zhwa phud de gus shing 'dud pa'i tshul mdzad cing zur ri bla ma don rin pas nyams 'ur mdzad pas chibs rags pa thams cad snang ba 'gyur zhing*/

byin rlabs kyi zil phebs pa byung*/ de nub sgar du phebs nas sang nyin tshes gsum gyi snga dro rje nyid kyi zhal snga nas dang rgyal tshab sprul sku/ nang so mched/ zur ri lcog grwa'i bla ma gnyis sogs sku 'khor che gras nas nyung bsdus kyis lhun rtse'i gzim khang du mchog sprul mjal bar phebs/ de yang rje nyid kyis/ phal pa rnams la bya ba lta bus brtag pa la sogs pa ni phal cher gzhan dbang gi mthu dang*/ 'ga' zhig mi ma yin gyis bskul ba'i 'phrul dang*/ 'ga' zhig las dbang gis skye ba dran pa'i gang zag la ste/ tshur mthong gi blo'i ra ba las brgal ba bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas 'di lta bu la rtog dpyod phra mos rgyas 'gebs ni dmus long gis gzugs 'jal ba ltar tshad mar mi 'gyur zhing*/ de lta'i brtag pa tsam po pa ni gyi nar gyur te/ 'dir the tshom gyi rtog pa ring nas bral ba'i nges pa brtan po rje nyid rang gi zab klong du ji ltar shar tshul las/ nam langs nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba la yin min skye bo su zhig sgrogs/ de'i phyir rang bzhin phal dang ma 'dres pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi kun spyod skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid ches gsal ba rtog pa po rnams kyang yid dang ba thob par gyur pa de ni mngon sum du grub bo//

de nas bkra shis kha btags nyin bde ma srid du ring ba'i mjal dar dang phyag 'bul byin rlabs zhu ba rje gong ma la ji ltar zhu ba bzhin mdzad/ mchog sprul yang thugs zhum pa bag tsha ba med par byin rlabs gnang ba dang*/ yang dang yang du gzigs shing dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dpag med mdzad/ gsol ja bzhi lnga tsam gyi ring bzhugs nas tshur phebs te/ gzim gur yol sgor dang bcas pa sngar gyi srol bzhin/ gser 'phru rgyal mtshan rlung dril ka 'phan bla bre yol ba rnams kyis spras pa/ bzhugs khri la drung de bzhin gshegs par gong ma ta'i ming gis phul ba'i ding phon gyi sa stan/ si'u'i pad 'bol/ mu tig gi sku bsnye sogs bshams shing*/ g.yas ngos su rten gsum gyi bshams bkod spyi dang khyad par rje gong ma'i yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i dngul skuu rdzu 'phrul ma mchod pa'i yo byad du ma dang bcas te bshams pa la sogs pa'i bkod pa khyad par du 'phags pa dag mdzad de/ zla ba de nyid kyi tshes bcu gnyis rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor dang ldan pa'i nang mo snga bar lhun rtse'i ri zhol nas bzhugs sgar gyi bar yang zur cog grwa zur tho ba rnams kyis 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan rol mo dang bcas pa'i ser sbreng dang*/ sgar nas rgyang tsam gyi zam chung zhig yod pa nas rgyal tshab sprul sku nang so mched zur ri cog grwa'i bla ma rnams kyis spos bsu dang*/ rje nyid kyang snam sbyar dang sgom zhwa mnabs te dngul gyi spos phor a ga ru'i bdug pas spud pa bsnams nas gzim yol gyi sgo mdor phebs pa sogs bsu bkod rgya chen pos mchog sprul sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan du spyan 'dren mdzad de/ rgyal ba gong ma'i seng ge'i khri chen por phebs pa'i bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi 'bul ja thog ma'i zhal dkar 'degs pa gnang ba la/ rje mchog sprul nas phyag reg pa dang gzim gur la nyi ma shar ba dus mtshungs su byung bas thams cad rten 'brel shin tu legs zhes gleng*/

de nas dpon slob gzhi byes kun gyis legs ja dga' ston gyi 'bul nod rgya chen mdzad nas/ rje gong ma la ji lta ba bzhin dbu zhwa 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag rje bla ma nyid kyis mchog gi sprul pa'i skur sgron pa mdzad de zhwa nag gi cod pan gsol/ rje nyid kyang sku gzhog g.yon ngos su srab stan la sku 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs/ phyag mdzod nas dpon slob gzhi byes rags bsdus la bur ston gyi zhal dro zhus shing*/ dge 'dun rnams kyis bkra shis rdzas rtags 'bul ba sogs kyis shis brjod mdzad/ de nas gandho las gtsos pa'i rten mchod sku chas bzhugs sgar rnams rim pas rtsis 'bul mdzad de phyag mdzod du nang so lcags mo gu shri pa bskos nas/ nang so sku bgres pa re zhig kun spangs kyi tshul dang*/ gzhon pas rje nyid kyi phyag g.yog khur len mdzad cing*/ spyi khyab kyi tsho 'dzin dang bka' gnang dgos pa gang ci rje'i zhal snga nas nyid kyis khur bzhes nas mchog gi sprul sku'i mdzad 'phrin spel ba la thugs la skyo dub med par bzhugs/ der chu gnyis bar zhig tu sgar 'phos mdzad nas mchog sprul la bka' chos kyi thog mar rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang*/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma/ lha dgu drung mdzad kyi tshe dpag med phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa'i dbang rnams 'bul ba mdzad cing*/ nang so bgres pa bsnyen par rdzogs/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun la mchog sprul dbu lo bsil te/ de yang dge 'dun yang ri'i tshogs gur du jo bo gandho la bshams pa'i drung du gtsug phud bzhes shing*/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang*/ thugs bskyed gnang nas mtshan dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug tu gsol/ sgar chos sde dang bcas par gsol 'debs dpal ldan khyab bdag ma yang 'dzugs pa mdzad/ sgar gyi bya ba che phra gang la'ang mchog sprul nas bka' phebs byung na 'phral 'thad min ji ltar na'ang bka' bzhin tshad mar 'dzin par mdzad/

bka' gros las thugs thag ma chod pa'i rigs kyang drung la dgongs pa zhu gsungs nas ji phebs ltar thugs thag gcod pa las sku nar ma son dgongs tshod ye mi gnang zhing*/ zla ba de nyid kyi bco lngar kre shod kyi mthil shugs ri thang du sgar gral bsgrig pa mdzad nas zla gcig lhag tsam bzhugs/ rgyal tshab sprul sku nang so bgres pa sogs la dus mkhyen bka' 'bum dang rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum las sgrub thabs skor gyi pusti'i lung sogs bka' chos 'phel bar mdzad/ de nas 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i sde mgon khang gi rten mjal la phebs shing*/ de zhor char 'bebs mdzad pas than pa'i gnod pa byung ba'ang zhi/ der bzhag bla ma spyan 'dren du 'byor bzhin 'dra yul la btegs/ shel khog nas sprul pa'i sku sgar du spyan 'dren grub pa'i gtam snyan sgrogs par dge slong kham bu ba sogs gser yig la brdzangs/ dar mdo nas zhing gi mi chen gyis gtsos pa'i dpon rnams dang*/ rab sgang mkhas pa mi lnga'i sde rnams kyis ja 'dren dang legs ja sleb/ der nyin gcig ri gzigs la phebs nas bzhugs pa'i pha wang la zhabs rjes byon/ zla ba bdun par 'dra tsher lung dgon du phebs/ der bzhag bla dpon slob mchod yon kun gyis 'bul zhabs rgya cher bsgrubs shing dus mkhyen bka' 'bum las dbang dang rjes gnang rdzogs par 'bul ba dang*/ bzhag bla mched kyis zhus nas yang ri'i tshogs gur du gandho la'i rten shoms rgyas pa mdzad nas gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun kun la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sems bskyed gnang*/ slar shel khog nas brgyud/ kre shod du phebs pa na/ si tu rin po che sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'bul ba sogs 'byor/ lhun rtser dgun bzhugs mdzad de/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i spa lcag skor gyi sgrub pa zhag bdun phrag gsum tsam mdzad/ de nas rje sprul pa'i sku sgar du phebs pa'i sku rim dang lo gsar thog ma gzabs pa mdzad pa'i smon lam gyi zhabs tog lcags mos bgyis nas gandho la'i rten shoms rgyas pa dang*/

nyin re bzhin yab sras tshogs dbur phebs shing*/ gung tshigs thon pa dang dge 'dun rnams la zab mo nang don bshad pa thun re yang stsal/ bco lnga'i nyin gso sbyong dang ser sbreng phyag skor mdzad/ khyi lo'i sos rje mchog sprul sku 'khor nyung shas bcas lhun rtser bzhugs/ rje nyid sgar chos sde bcas lcags mo dang skam rtse ba thug pa'i dum mdzad par dben gyang du phebs/ rgyal tshab sprul skur chos 'byung bsdus pa gsal ba'i zin thun gnang*/ glang thang rab 'byams pa sogs kyi 'bul skyel gtos che ba sleb/ rje mchog sprul kyang lhun rtse nas bzhugs sgar nyin skor zhig la phebs/ de nas chibs rags chu phar khar rje dus mkhyen dang spyan snga'i 'khrungs sa/ dus mkhyen gyi lha mo bsgrubs pa'i gnas lha mo phug khri ral gyis bzhengs pa'i kre ka brag gi gtsug lag khang rnams kyi gnas mjal la phebs yul mi rnams kyis nas 'bul mang du byung ba sgar chos sde kun la gshog bgos su stsal/ 'dzom thang chos rje rgyal seng ba'i spyan 'dren pa rim par sleb par brten/ rgyal bzang mdor yab sras zhal 'dzom gyis zla ba lnga par shar khar chibs bsgyur te zhar du sku zo thog gi gnas mjal dang*/ snye rol du ser 'bras sogs kyi grwa rgyun dang*/ 'jang rgyal blon bla ma rnams dang bcas kyi 'bul skyel ba rnams kyis rim par 'bul chen bgyis/ de nas rdo rol nas 'dzi ka thang du phebs/ der rje nyid nas sprul pa'i skur rje don ldan zhabs dang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i bka' 'bum na bzhugs pa'i dbang bka' rnams 'bul ba dang*/ tshogs chos su sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid gnang*/ zla ba dgu par 'dzam thang dgon par phebs/ chos rje dang mjal 'phrad mdzad cing dpon slob sde dgon rnams kyis 'bul ba dang*/ zhabs tog bla nas bla lhag tu bsgrubs/ chos rje rang gi gzim khang du phebs nas bka' dbang mang du stsal/ dgon de'i tshogs pa nyis stong du nye bar phal mo cher rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa ci rigs stsal/

chos rje nyid kyis dge bskul du dgongs te shar ngos pha gir khong rang phyag 'og tu gtogs pa'i yul bzhag shod zhes skad rigs mi gcig pa klo mon lta bur 'dug pa'i lung par spyan drangs pas khong rnams shar ja dang mar chur sogs kyi 'bul mchod rgya cher zhus shing*/ srog gcod spong ba yig drug 'don pa la sogs pa'i dge ba'i khas len kyang yang dag bsgrubs/ dgun stod mgo log dpon po rnams kyis smar stod chen thang du spyan drangs te/ mgo log dang be 'phrog kun gyis mjal zhing rta khrab gos dar go mtshon sogs dngos bdog ci yod pa ltos med du phul/ dge bskul rgya cher mdzad/ slar shel khog tu phebs/ sngar zhu lan dang bstun rje dpa' bo nas gtsos/ gsung rab gling nas rtse lha sgang yan gyi kar sde kun dang*/ thel/ 'bri/ stag /rtse/ gong dkar/ rin spungs/ 'phyong rgyas/ yar rgyab/ yar stod/ sku rab/ kong po'i dpon rgya bdag la sogs pa bla ma slob dpon dang*/ sde dpon rigs kun nas ja 'dren gyi 'bul ba/ spyan 'dren gyi mi sna so so nas gtos che ba 'byor/ dpon sa gong ma gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsngo rten kyang 'byor/ de nas zhing gi mi chen grags rgyal pas gtsos dar mdo'i dpon stag 'du rnams dang*/ rab sgang mkhas pa mi lnga'i sde rnams kyis spyan 'dren ched 'byor bzhin/ ta'u nas brgyud mi mtshor phag lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ zla ba dang po'i nyer bdun la dar mdor phebs nyin dpon g.yog mang pos las gos dang rol mo'i bye brag sogs rgyal po'i lung gis che ba'i bkod pa tshad med pas bsus te grong dang ha cang mi nye ba'i chu ngogs su bzhugs sgar mdzad/ rgya bod kyi zhal mjal ba bgrang ba las 'das pa dang*/ mdo pa'i gzhi ba rgya bod kyi tshong pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis gser dngul dang ja gos dar rgya zog ngo mtshar ba'i rnam grangs du ma dang bcas pa'i 'bul ba rgya che grangs mang sa gzhi de'i khyon gang ba tsam du bgyis shing thams cad la zhal mjal gsung thos kyi 'brel ba dang*/

gandho la sogs kyi rten mjal rgyas par gnang shing*/ dus bzang rnams la rgya pan kun gyis spos dang mar me 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs pa dag khyer te bzhugs sgar la bskor ba byed pa dang*/ dgongs mo rgya'i rtse sna mang po'i khyad mtshar gyi gzigs mo 'bul ba'ang byed mgo thom nas rab 'byams pa kar chos kyis gnas bcu'i si thang gis gtsos rgya zog mang du phul ba sogs gzhan yang phyogs kun nas 'bul mchod bgrang du med pa'o// der ling tshe dpon gyis spyan 'dren nan chags bgyis kyang zhal ma bzhes pas/ khong rang gi bu che ba na bza' gsol dpyad ja gos gser dngul rta drel sogs gyi 'bul chen ltos cher tshur phul/ sha sing dpon sogs kyis kyang tshul de lta bu'i bsnyen bkur sogs mtha' yas/ de tshe rje mi la gangs zhol chu klung gi ngog brag steng ljon pa'i bsil grib tu tshe ring mched lngas dngos grub mdangs gsol du 'bul ba'i tshul gyis bskor zhing sku'i phyogs bzhir rmi lam ka chen bzhi'i mgur las byung ba'i srog chags bzhi gser ris su yod pa zhig skya bris zhib tshag phyag bris dang*/ de gong phyag dpe'i dbu lhar thugs rje chen po yi ge drug pa zhwa nag cod pan can mdzad pa rnams zhal gzigs su byung nas yin par gleng*/ la mo rtse'i sgrub sder zhabs kyis bcags shing gso ba dang mdo pa shog gsum nas gces phrug sum cu tsam gyi grwa rgyun dang*/ dgon thes kyi cha rkyen mang du sbyar/ der rgya'i rol mo mkhan mi chen gyi zho shas 'tsho ba zhig kun nas dad pas rab tu byung zhing zhabs phyir 'brangs te bka' chos dang*/ 'dus byas chos rnams rmi lam yul lta bu/ /zhes sogs yang dag pa'i don gyi gdams pa'ang gnang nas sgo gsum dge ba la gcig tu brtson par gyur/ yangs can gos sku'i zhal khebs rgyu ched du dad bskul mdzad pa'i sman tse ltos che ba rnams sogs yar brdzangs/

mkhas pa mi lnga'i sde rnams su rim pas phebs te so so'i mkhan slob grwa mang yon bdag dang bcas gus pas bsnyen bkur ba'i yon yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ dgon gnas re rer yang grwa pa brgya phrag la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab pa dang chos kyi bka' drin gyis tshim par mdzad/ ra ti pa kun gyis zhus ngor gnas bstod kyang mdzad/ kar lugs su gtog pa'i bla ma slob dpon bsko bzhag dgos pa kun mchog sprul snyan du gsol te bsko bzhag gnang*/ de nas 'jang rgyal po'i ti shri drung pa sogs spo 'bor ba'i grwa yon kun nas zhu bzhin/ kam po'i gdan sar phebs lam nyag rong dang mgo log la btog pas/ ngom sgang du bzhag bla dpon slob kyis 'bul zhabs yun ring bzhus par/ de dag tu rgyal tshab sprul sku sogs la rgyud sde spyi'i rnam bshad dang nang brtag rgyud gsum don bsdus dang bcas stsal/ 'ja' mo lar sman 'ji dgon nas chos rje dang*/ 'jang rgyal po'i blon po sogs rang rang dbang 'byor gyis bkod pas mjal zhing*/ sman 'ji kun spangs pas zab mo nang don las brtsams pa'i dri ba'i zhu phrin snga phyir phul ba la/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dngos mi bskyod bzang*// zhes sogs kyi dri lan rgyas par stsal bas thugs rangs par mdzad/ de nas zla ba bcu pa'i yar tshes la gdan sa kaṃ po'i gnas sgor phebs/ gnas nang gi gnas mjal zhib par gnang zhing gnas sgor grub chen rin po ches bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku bzhugs pa la zhal gser sogs gtsug lag khang phyi nang thams cad du mchod pa rgya cher bstar shing*/ nang so spungs ri ba sogs gnas phyi nang pa kun gyis mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur legs par bsgrubs/ ras gzhir sgar dang bcas pa'i gnas kyi bkod pa'i ri mo'ang mdzad/ 'jang gi ti shri bla ma sogs mang po byon nas 'bul zhabs cher bgyis/ byi ba'i lo gsar dang smon lam gnang ba'i tshes bcu bzhir mchog sprul la/

dge 'dun rnams kyis thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung gi bka' 'brel gsol ba btab pas rje nyid kyang bzhugs khri las mthil du phebs nas gsan par mdzad/ smon lam thon nas mchog sprul zhabs phyir rgyal tshab sprul sku sogs dang dge 'dun nyi shu skor bcas la de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi ljags lung gi dbu tshugs/ 'jang rgyal blon rnams la yab sras so so'i bka' shog gnang skyes gser yig pa bcas brdzangs gnang*/ bla ma rgya bya ba la spung ri'i gdan sa'i khur dgos kyi bka' bkod dang*/ gnyer dam nan chags mdzad/ der spung ri nang so ba sogs 'ba' la bzhi bar gyi grwa rigs dang kong po ba sogs rnams ja zhus spyan 'dren 'byor ltar 'ba' thang phyogs la chibs bsgyur stag shod du phebs thog rgyal yab a rdor gshegs pa'i spur bzhu dang mchod rten sogs kyi zhal bkod gnang*/ de nas 'ba' rgya spang steng du phebs/ de'i grwa rigs yon bdag rnams dang*/ tsha ba sgang rong kha ba dkar tshun gyi skye bo dpag med 'dus te/ gser dngul ja gos/ rta drel sogs kyi 'bul zhabs mtha' klas shing*/ sa tham nas 'jang rgyal blon sogs kyi 'bul skyel gser yig pa rnams 'byor/ der bka' 'gyur las mdo sde 'ga' zhig gi lung gzhi byes kun la gnang*/ mchog sprul snyan du yang gsol nas 'jang kong bar gyi 'dun 'jags mdzad/ shar phyogs spung ri dang*/ 'dam chen rtse ra'i gnas zhib mjal sogs mdzad/ slar gnas sgor phebs/ rgyud 'bum gyi 'phro rdzogs par gnang*/ rgyal tshab sprul skur gos chen dkar po la thugs dam rten du 'dzin rgyu'i bde mchog sku phyag bris ngo mtshar can

gnang*/ nyin gcig dbyar gzigs dang gnas mjal sbrags gnas nang gi chos 'byung steng gi de'u 'bob chung ngu zhig gi khar bzhugs pa'i zhal dkar bzhugs gding gi zur du bsnyal nas 'jog pa gnang ba de'u de'i rtsa bar 'dril ba spos 'dzin pas yar blangs byung ba la spu shang tsam gyi chag gas ma byung 'dug pas ngo mtshar par mngon/ der li thang ba kun gyis gdan 'dren bzhin dbyar bzhugs li thang du phebs/ de nas khro tsha bla ma dang*/ cha dkar dpon sogs khrom gzhung na yod pa'i sog po mchod yon rnams kyis spyan 'dren zhus nas khrom gzhung dang 'bom nyag brgyud de kre stod stong mo gru sor phebs te bka' 'gyur las yum rgyas pa'i ljags lung dbu tshugs shing*/ der gzim gur gsar bzo'i gur ston dang bstun nas rje sprul pa'i sku'i drung du gandho la'i mchod gdan du gos gser leb thags kyi rten khebs chibs gser gas gtsos pa'i 'bul ba rgya cher phul zhing dbu zhwa sgron nas dbus su rje dpa' bo sku na smin pa dang sku gcong bar yong 'dug pa nas bod la myur du spyan 'dren dgos pa'i bka' nan byung tshul gyi zhu 'bul mdzad/ ston rgyab lhun rtse'i dgon du bzhugs/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la dbus su chibs bsgyur ba'i dgongs pas btegs/ kre shod du gling bdag pos 'bul chen dang*/ rdza rgyud du 'go log dpon rnams dang gling bar pas 'gu zir spyan drangs nas 'bul chen bsgrubs/ der shing glang lo gsar smon lam/ du si zhal ngo rnams la chos 'brel/ dge 'dun phal cher la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi bka' drin rnams stsal/ de nas 'dan glang thang sgrol ma'i gtsug lag sogs nas/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i dgon byang chub gling du phebs/ mnyan sprul bas 'bul zhabs cher zhus/ rten gtor rnams gso ba dang*/ rgya rol lung*/ chos rje 'bri sgang pa dul dbon gling dpon sogs 'bri rgyud kyi skya ser dpag med 'dus pa la dam chos kyis tshim par mdzad/

drung pa/ spung ri ba sogs pas spyan 'dren ltar lha thog brgyud/ karmar phebs nas phyi nang gi rten mjal dang*/ g.yen mo cher gandho la'i rten shom rgyas pa dang gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun khri tsho tsam la karma chos 'byung gi lung dang smon 'jug sems bskyed sogs gnang*/ rje nyid nas ma na hu'i dkar gzugs shin tu legs pa/ g.yu seng ge zho spungs kyang gandho la'i mchod rdzas su phul/ bka' 'gyur shes rab sna tshogs pusti'i ljags lung dang*/ mchog sprul snyan du'ang gsol nas snga srol gyi lugs legs su drung pa kong por 'byon pa'i zhal ta bcas sogs gnang*/ zur mang dang tshang gsar pas spyan 'dren ltar zur mang du phebs te/ sde dgon gyi 'bul mchod rgya cher spros/ chos rje legs bshad sgra dbyangs pas gtsos gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun stong phrag tsam la 'du khang du mi bskyod zhabs kyi rlung sems gnyis med kyi khrid lung dang*/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs ci rigs bcas sogs stsal/ tshang gsar gu shri zhal ngo rnams kyis snying thang du spyan drangs/ ri khag bco brgyad dang 'brong pa'i mi sde bcas kun gyis rta khrab gnag phyugs sogs kyi 'bul ba dpag med bgyis shing*/ slob dpon padma'i gter gnas spyi 'byams brag gi gnas mjal kyang mdzad/ de nas gsal stong sgom pa'i phug dang*/ dus mkhyen gnas re ne sogs nas brgyud de sku 'bum du nang chen pas 'bul mchod mang du bgyis/ de nas ri che'i lha sde mi sde kun gyis snga phyir spyan 'dren ltar/ zla ba bdun par ri cher phebs te mi dpon dang mkhan slob chos gsum rnams kyis phebs bsu dang*/ bkra shis sgo mang du chos rje mtsho skyes khu dbon gyis dad pas zhabs la gtugs shing dbang bka' chos lung mang du gsan/ rgya bod kyi rten khyad can 'ga' shas kyis thog drangs pa'i 'bul bsnyen bla lhag tu mdzad/ lha khang dang yang dgon sku 'bum sogs kyi rten mjal mdzad/

lho rong nas nang so gu shris 'bul zhabs rgya chen bcas mjal du byon par dbang chos mang du gnang*/ der sgar gyi mgur mkhan dge slong snying po bzod pa grogs mched kyis rje gong ma rnams kyi gsung mgur gyi sdeb tu 'then rgyu'i mgur dbyangs dang bcas pa zhig gnang dgos zhus par/ bsam blo btang na bka' drin che bde/ /zhes sogs rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i mgur gnang zhing*/ zur mang chos rje legs bshad sgra dbyangs pa 'di bar bka' chos zhu bar zhabs phyir byon pa dang*/ ri bo che'i chos rje la yang so sor bslab bya dang zhal gdams zab cing rgya che ba gnang*/ sog zam nas 'brong bu gu shri mched kyis spyan 'dren dang*/ hor dang nang chen stod ma'i ja 'dren rnams lhags/ yar bteg lam du rgya ston chos rjes ba dan dgon du spyan drangs/ lho nas dge 'dun rgyal mtshan pa mjal du byon te dpon zhig phyags phyir phul ba sogs gus zhabs ches cher zhus/ hor bsod rgyal ru thog phebs/ zur ri bla ma grongs pa'i sku gdung gi mchod rten zhal bskos gnang*/ de nas sog zam dgon du phebs/ gu shri sku mched sde dgon rnams kyis 'bul zhabs legs par bgyis/ rje dpa' bo'i drung nas ja 'dren dang zhu yig pa sleb/ sog la'i rgyab tu spo bo'i kar srid rnams kyi ja 'dren dang rta 'bul ba rnams 'byor/ de nas byang lam brgyud de rim pas phebs pa'i lam bar rnams su phyag chen rgya gzhung gi lung 'bul ba gnang zhing*/ 'ba' rom pa dang dbu ma brag dkar ba rnams kyis so so'i dgon gnas su spyan drangs nas bsnyen bkur cher bgyis/ stag lung chos rje phebs pas ja 'dren sogs phul/ 'dam du nang so ban sgar ba dang rong po chen po dpon g.yog mchod yon rnams kyi 'bul dpang bstod/ der lha mdongs lo tsā ba dang*/ nang so sgo pa sogs phyag 'bul du 'byor/ kong pa spyan sngas kong dgon du spyan drangs nas bsnyen bkur dpag med bgyis/

dkar po chu rgyud du yangs can nas drung nas dbon gu shri khu dbon dge 'dun che bsgres rnams phebs bsu phyag 'bul du byon/ zla ba bcu gcig pa la yangs can du phebs/ rtse lteng du bzhugs sgar mdzad/ zla dkar gyi tshes gsum nas bzhugs yul gtsug lag khang du gnang ba'i thog mar gzim khang bkra shis gsar mar phebs/ drung nas khu dbon gyi gzhi len gyi gsol ston rgya cher zhus/ lho nas dge bshes sangs dpal ba sogs phyag 'bul 'byor/ de nas de nyid kyi tshes bcu skor la gdan sa mtshur phur phebs/ gdan sa pa dpon slob kyis thabs bsu dang*/ dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbreng bkra shis khra ring bre ba la sogs pa bsu ba'i bkod chen gyis spyan drangs/ de ltar rje nyid kyi 'phrin las rnam par dkar bas rgyal dbang mchog gi sprul pa'i sku mdo smad kyi char sprul pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i gnas nas spyan drangs te yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyi skye bo phal mo che'i gus pa'i yon yongs su sbyong zhing dge ba'i lam la gzud par mdzad nas rje mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor gdan sa chen po'i mchog gi khri 'phangs su bkod de/ mchog dman gyi skye dgu yongs la zhal dkyil mngon sum du snang bar mdzad pa la gcig tu dad pas/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gling nas dga' tshal yan gyi dge 'dun so so'i bla slob dpon dang bcas pa/ dbus gtsang gi sde dpon ris 'gos che ba gzhan yang gra yon mtha' dag tshogs nas ja 'dren dang zhal mjal phyag 'bul bsgrubs/ stag lo'i lo gsar gnang zhing bde chen nas drung nas kyis zhabs tog mdzad/ gandho la'i rten shom rgyas pa dang gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun stong brgyad brgya tsam gyis smon lam mdzad pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin mchog sprul dbus su phebs pa'i dga' ston gyi 'bul ba dpangs che ba zhig mdzad nas dbu zhwa 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag sgron te tshogs pa rnams la thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung dang*/

bco lngar dwags po'i chos bzhi'i bka' 'brel rje nyid kyang bzhugs khri las mthil du phebs nas gsan pa mdzad/ rje dbon mdzod par bsko ba gnang ste/ rje dpa' bo'i dgongs pa bskang slad/ zla ba gnyis par mtshur phu nas gdan bteg /chu shul smyug la ba rnams kyis so so'i zhabs tog dang legs bshad gling du karma phrin las pa'i dngul gdung la phyag mchod gnang*/ gong dkar nas zhabs drung dpon blon las tshan gzab shom dang bcas mjal bar byon nas 'bul dpangs bstod/ de nas dpal de ba dang*/ sna dkar nas khri dpon sogs rnams kyis rim par spyan 'dren dang bsnyen bkur zhu bzhin pas/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la sras mkhar dgyes rdor gtsug lag khang du phebs te rje dpa' bo nyid sku gcong ba'i stabs kyis/ chos la'i thog tu chos rje sras pas gtsos pa'i thab bsu dang*/ dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbreng gis bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs/ de ma thag rje nyid dpa' bo'i drung du phyag 'bul la phebs/ de nas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i drung dang mjal bar mdzad pas dgongs pa yongs su gang zhing dgyes pa mchog tu gyur/ rje nyid kyi phyag tu rin po che dpa' bo nyid kyi bka' 'bum cha tshang phul ba sogs gzhi len gyi zhabs tog dang 'bul rlabs ches che ba mdzad/ yar stod dpon sa chos mdzad ma yang mjal phyag tu byon/ tshes bcu dgu gza' skar sbyor byed bzang por gzim spyil utpal 'dab rgyas su ston pa'i sku li ma khyad can du ma bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rje nyid kyis mkhan po dang*/ rje dpa' bos las slob/ gzhan zhu byed dang zhu gnas kyi dge 'dun mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dbus su rje mchog sprul rin po ches rab byung dang dge tshul gyi bslab pa bzhes pa'i zhabs phyir rgyal tshab sprul sku bcas rab tu byung ba mdzad/ mchog sprul drung du mtshan yang gsol/ de'i tshe rab byung gsol ba dang*/

dge 'dun gyi tshogs dung grags pa 'grigs pas rten 'brel legs par mngon/ de nas rje dpa' bo'i drung nas dpon slob lhan rgyas kyis phyag chen chos drug sbyor drug rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub bka' srung dud sol ma'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa rnams gsan pa dang*/ rje nyid nas kyang gnas kyi khyad par la dgongs te rje mchog sprul drung du rngog dkyil bdun gyi dbang dang dus 'khor 'grel chen gyi lung 'bul ba mdzad/ yab sras bka' bgros nas dge 'dun zur ri ba rnams kyi bla ma dbu mdzad sogs bsko bzhag mang du mdzad/ gzim chung du rje dpa' bo'i bris sku zhig 'dug pa'i 'og tu yang*/ srid pa'i gdung ba mtha' dag rab 'joms pa/ /zhes sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs bcad phyag bris mdzad nas 'bul ba sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i gus pa dpag med mdzad de/ dpon slob gzhi byes thams cad dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston sku nyams su bstar zhing dgyes bzhin/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu dgu la yab sras slar lho stod du phebs pa sde pa mched kyis lha lung dang gnas su zhabs tog cher bgyis/ de nas sna dkar rtse sogs brgyud/ smyug la ba dpon blon gyis bteg ste bka' 'gyur lung 'phro kha shas dang*/ legs gling pa dpon slob la bka' chos 'phel bar mdzad/ der rje nyid kyis mkhan po dang*/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang gi mkhan chen dang*/ legs bshad gling gi chos rje kun spangs pa sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang gis rgyal tshab sprul sku bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas bsil sna gzhung du hor stod pas 'bul zhabs/ bde chen nas drung nas kyis zhabs tog rnams mdzad nas/ 'bri rdzi'i gangs kyi lha zhol du bka' 'gyur las phal chen dkon brtsegs rnams kyi ljags lung phul/ chos don gnyer 'dus pa kun la rang mos bzhin gyi khrid lung mang du gnang*/ der slob dpon mkhas chen rnam rgyal grags pa yab sras mjal phyag tu byon nas rang byung rje'i bslab gzhung mchan bus 'grel pa gzigs phul bas thugs rangs mdzad/
