zla ba brgyad pa'i gsum mchod grub nas bde chen dang yangs can du'ang phebs/ mtshur phur phebs nas/ dkon gnyer rje gong ma'i skabs ltar/ yang zur nas gzhi sde la bsko bzhag gnang*/ slar yangs can du phebs/ zla ba bcu par lha phu bas gtsang phyogs su spyan drangs ltar lam zhor jo mo gangs kyi gnas mjal kyang mdzad/ zab phu lung gi gnas mjal du'ang phebs shing*/ de nas bka' 'gyur las pusti kha shas lung mdzad skabs rje dpa' bo mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod bsngo'i rten 'bul ba dang dgongs rdzogs kyi dbur spyan 'dren pa sleb pa la rgyal tshab sprul sku gnang zhing sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs kyang stsal/ de nas yab sras chos sgar shangs rnam gling du phebs te/ sku mdun tshe rdor bas bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ kre bo sprul sku dang rin spungs pa'i rgyal bu yang phyag 'bul du byon/ chos sde gsung rab rgya mtsho gling du yos lo'i lo gsar smon lam gnang*/ rgyal tshab sprul sku tshur byon/ sku gdung gi cha shas phyag tu phul bas gus pa dpag med mdzad/ mi dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug gis mchog sprul zhal mngon du gyur pa'i dga' ston du rin spungs su spyan 'dren pa'i bya ma rta lha mdongs lo chen sogs 'byor/ mthong smon du phebs thog mkhas dbang dpal mchog bzang po sogs gser mdog can nas mkhan slob rnams kyis mjal zhing*/ sha ri'i gru kha nas thab bsu dang*/ ser sbreng sogs bsu ba'i bkod chen dang bcas mkha' ru steng klu sdings su phebs/ de nas tshoms chen du sde pa nyid kyis gsar bzhengs rigs ldan zhing khams rgya mtsho'i gos yol bre ba sogs 'byor bkod dpag tu med pas gzhis kar spyan drangs/ mchod dang bsnyen bkur bgrang pa las 'das pas zla ngo gsum tsam du srid zhu bgyis shing zhal ngo rnams la dbang chos kyi bka' drin ci rigs stsal/ der skyed tshal nas mkhan po gung pa sogs dpon slob rnams dang*/

byams chen sde dgon/ zang zang ne ring nas chos rje mched sogs rnams kyis mjal zhing 'bul mchod dang bka' chos mang du gsan/ dbon zhang dan bzhag sogs rgyal khams bde 'jags kyi bka' gnang yang legs par stsal te/ slar 'o yug brgyud/ dge bshes chos 'byung gnas rdo rje'i dgon gnas 'dabs 'dzom thang du rin spungs pa rang gis gling mkhar rdzong nas zhabs tog zhus te zla gcig lhag tsam bzhugs/ de nas snye mo bra bskor bar 'brong bu dgon rnying du zhig gsos dang bu khral gyi bka' bkod slob dpon bsko ba bcas gnang*/ bya mkhar nas chos rje dbon dge 'dun bcas dang*/ lo chen ratna bha dra'i sku skye grwa ris rnams kyis gdan drangs byung ba rje mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i drung du skra phud 'bul ba'i zhal bkod dang*/ de rnams la chos 'brel dang bdag rgyan ci rigs pa gnang*/ gzhu stod nas yangs can du phebs nas bzhugs thog mdo mang gi ljags lung 'phro ma lus par yongs su rdzogs/ yang ri'i bla ma bskos/ der dbus su dus gzings langs pa'i bde thabs su spyan 'dren par chos rje kun rtse ba sogs rim 'byor bzhin smyug la brgyud phebs/ gong dkar du sras yum rnams kyis mjal zhing skyid shongs kyi brag chen du phebs te lho byang tshang mar bde 'jags kyi bka' gnang bas/ dmag thog gi sde rigs che phra dmag mang kun gyis gus pas mjal zhing bka' stsal ltar dpung rnams so sor gyes nas chings don la 'khod/ der 'brug lo'i lo sar smon lam mdzad nas yar rgyab dpon chen nas tshal min du spyan drangs thog thugs gling nas sde pa mgon bkras gshegs pa'i 'dren don la sne'u gdong rtser spyan drangs te 'bul zhabs cher bgyis pa'i dge rtsa dge 'dun tshogs chen pa sogs kyi zhabs 'bring dang bcas pas byang chub tu yongs bsngo mdzad de slar tshal min du phebs/ dol mdar rgyal tshab sprul skur mdo sde rgyan 'grel zin thun bstsal/
phyis khra 'brug tu spyod 'jug bshad lung dka' gnas la zin thun kyang tho re ba bstsal/

de nas rim pas grwa thang dang*/ byams gling mchod rten mjal/ dpon sa gdung brgyud yum sras kyi dgongs rdzogs su khra 'brug na khar spyan drangs/ yab sras so sor sde srid na rim gyi thugs dam rten gtso thub sku zangs thang ma gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i rten gsum dang shel spyad sogs khyad nor du ma rnam grangs su bkod pa'i 'bul chen dang*/ thun mong dge ba rgyun chags kyi mchod gzhis 'bul ba sogs 'bul zhabs tshad med pa bgyis/ dus bzang rnams la gtsug lag khang du phyag mchod smon lam mdzad/ yum bu bla mkhar dang chos gra rtse thang du'ang phebs te rten rnams la phyag mchod dang*/ dge 'dun kun la chos dang zang zing gi phan pa bstsal/ der yar stod nas sde pa phun tshogs dang*/ dpon sa chos mdzad ma sogs mjal du byon pas dpon sar yig mkhan gyi mthun sbyor bka' bkod gnang nas mi bskyod rje'i bka' 'bum shog dmar la gser rkyang gis bzhengs pa'i grwa 'dzugs pa gnang*/ sne'u gdong rtser thugs gling pa mched kyis tshes bcu'i gzigs 'bul sogs la spyan 'dren te dge 'dun tshogs chen dpon slob rnams kyis ser sbreng sogs bsu ba'i bkod chen dang gus 'dud cher mdzad/ 'phyong rgyas sde pas spyan drangs nas 'bul dpangs rgya cher bstod/ ras chung phug dang shel brag so so'i dgon gnas su spyan drangs par sgrub pa'i zhal bkos mdzad/ thel nas spyan 'dren nan chags bzhin phebs/ phyi nang rten mjal mchod phyag dang*/ spyan sngar bde mchog bka' dbang sogs chos bka' ci rigs pa'ang bstsal/ de nas bsam yas su phebs/ dbu rtse dang gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla mchod skar sogs kyi gtsug lag khang rnams mjal mchod dang*/ nyin re bzhin byang chub chen po'i drung du phyag mchod smon lam rgyas pa mdzad/ 'chims phu dang sngags grwa rgyal byed tshal sogs zhabs kyis bcags shing sde dgon rnams kyis 'bul mchod dang*/

'phreng por dad ldan sde pa thub rgyal bas zla ba lhag tsam gyi bar bsnyen bkur rgya cher bsgrubs shing rje mchog sprul drung du phar phyin zin thun 'bul ba'i dbu 'dzugs pa gnang*/ der bal po'i bzo sbyong mkhas pa 'gar rje zhwa dmar nag gong ma 'ga'i tshems phyag tu bzhugs pa'i bzhugs khang gser gyi drwa tshag rin po che'i phras brgyan pa'i mchod rten sgo mang gi rnam pa khyad can gyi bzo bkod kyang mdzad/ de nas 'bri khung rin po che mched kyis sgar chen spyan drangs shing phebs nyin chos rje mched nyid thab bsur phebs pa'i rgya rags dang ser sbreng sogs bsu bkod dpag tu med pas bkra shis tshal du gdan phab/ chos 'khor sgang 'du khang du sne len gyi sgar ston dang*/ chibs rags thel du spyan drangs te phyi nang rten mjal dang*/ chos rje na rim la gong nas gnang ba'i 'ja' sa tham ka sogs gzigs 'bul mdzad/ chos rje dang paṇa chen mched sku 'khor bcas rnams la rdor phreng chag lugs dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad pa'i dbang sogs bstsal zhing*/ gzhan yang chos don gnyer gyi skye bo du ma'ang dbang khrid bshad lung gdams ngag ci rigs pas tshim par mdzad/ der rgyal tshab sprul sku ra sgreng rgyal ba'i gnas chen rten gsum la mchod phyag dang*/ mtshur phu'i gser thog zhig gsos sogs su brdzangs gnang*/ zla ba gnyis tsam bsnyen bkur zhing 'bul chen dpag med stobs te rim pas stag lung du phebs pa'i lam zhor phag mo rtser gnas rnying gi si thang las sman thang pas bshus pa'i ston pa'i mdzad thang ri mo'i bkod pa khyad mtshar la lha bzo nam bkras la de 'dra ba zhig brir bzhengs bkas gnang ltar legs par grub pa'i zhal yig dang*/ bsngags pa'i tshul du mdzad pa bcu gnyis rnam bzhag mdor bsdus dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bral smin gyi yon tan ston pa'i gzhung rnams bkrol ba dar zab la gser gyi yi ger bkod pa zhal thang gi g.yas g.yon du bkram chog pa bcas mdzad/

stag lung rje rtse pa dang grogs kha ba mched sogs kyis gcig tu gus pas mchod dang bsnyen bkur dpag med zhus bka' chos kyis thugs 'gangs par mdzad/ grwa mang khams bod kun gyis 'bul zhabs rgya cher bgyis te rang rang mos pa dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi bka' drin zhus/ mchod khang sogs kyi rten gsum mjal mchod zhib par mdzad nas/ 'phan yul sogs brgyud/ yangs can du phebs te dgun bzhugs skabs spo kong gi kar srid kun gyis spyan 'dren rta 'bul ba stag lung nas chos rje rtse pa'ang bka' chos gsan par phebs/ sbrul lo'i lo gsar dang smon lam gandho la'i rten shoms dang smon lam grol ba'i ser sbreng shis brjod kyi tshe 'brug sgra grags pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung*/ de nas rje mchog sprul drung du chos drug gi bka' dpe gong 'og sogs dang*/ rngog pa'i man ngag phyag dreg ma'i skor/ dus mkhyen bka' 'bum/ bka' brgyud gser phreng rnams kyi lung dang*/ stag lung chos rje dpon slob rnams la rang byung rje'i 'grel pa'i thog nas sbyor drug nyams khrid gnang zhing*/ chos rje'i gsol btab ngor 'grel pa de nyid bsdus pa'i khrid yig kyang mdzad/ yangs can mkhan po kun spang bgyis pa'i gdan sar cog grwa bla ma bsko ba dang*/ gling khrims la sogs pa'i bca' yig kyang zhib tu gnang zhing*/ sman thang dpal bkras pa lags la gos ta hung la mu tig bkod pa'i thugs rje chen po kha sashtsa ṇa'i sku zhig bzhengs su 'jug pa mdzad/ zla ba bzhi par mtshur phur phebs te/ de skabs gser thog gi bzo yang bya brang gnyis kyi gser zangs gso dgos kha shas tsam ma gtogs phal cher grub pa gzigs gnang du pheb cing phyag nas zhus pas legs so'i bka' stsal dang gser sil ma zho brgya phrag sogs kyi cha rkyen kyang stsal/ dgongs gcig bla ma lha khang steng nas gzigs rtog gnang skabs bsam yas dbu rtse'i gan ji ra'i rtser shel yod pa de legs par 'dug tshul gsungs gleng byung bas/

'di la yang de ltar byas na yong gsungs nas rgyag lugs 'di ltar gyis bka' bkod bcas chu shel chen po gnang ba gan ji ra'i rtser phul bas mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar gyur/ yab sras bka' bgros nas mtshur phu'i dkon gnyer gyi bzhi sde yang zur res mos kyis 'dzin pa de ka'i rgyas gnyer grogs dan gyi bka' bcas kyis phyis 'du khang chen mo'i bshu 'bigs shing rtsi dang bcas legs par grub pa byung*/ de nas gnas nang du phebs/ snang rtse rig 'dzin pa sogs la snyan brgyud rdo rje zam pa'i dbang lung rdzogs par gnang*/ rtse gdong bdag chen kyang mjal du phebs te 'bul mchod dang bka' dbang mang du gsan/ slar na mgor yab sras chos gzhis bod 'brog rnams la bu khral gnang ste gnas nang gi grwa tshang btsugs shing yangs can mkhan cham kha ba slob dpon du bskos shing*/ rgyal la brgyud/ bander phebs nas rje dpa' bo'i sprul sku zhal bdag gnang*/ rgyud pa grwa tshang ba dang chu shul ba mchod yon gyis gzhi len dang 'bul zhabs/ gong dkar du zhabs drung sras yum gyis spyan drangs te 'bul mchod rgya cher stobs shing bka' dbang sogs thugs kha tshim par mdzad/ na kha sbug tu smyug la ba dpon blon gyis zhabs bsnyen zhus nas/ bzhugs ring rje mchog sprul drung du grub chen pakshi'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshang mar bka' chos shin tu 'phel/ rgyal tshab sprul skus gser thog gso ba grub nas phebs pa 'byor/ de nas yar 'brog dpal de bas spyan drangs yun ring zhabs tog bgyis skabs kha rag shar gyi gnas gzigs su phebs shing 'bras spungs sprul pa'i sku bsod nams rgya mtsho dpon slob phyag 'bul du phebs pa dang mjal 'dzom rten 'brel legs tshogs che bar byung*/ sna dkar rtser khri dpon mched kyis yun ring zhabs 'debs zhus nas gandho la sogs sgar gyi rten mjal zhib par gnang*/

rje btsun ma o rgyan mtsho mo dpon slob kyis dzam gling chos 'khor du spyan drangs nas 'bul zhabs dpag med dang*/ bka' chos zhus shing*/ de dag gi tshe yar rgyab na sgo brgyad pa zer ba'i lha bzor mi bskyod rje'i dngul sku mdzub mtho gang pa sgros legs pa zhig bzhengs su gnang ste rgyun bsnams 'bral spangs mdzad/ de nas sras gro bo lung rnams su phebs/ rje dpa' bo'i dngul gdung la rab gnas dang*/ sprul pa'i sku khri thog tu mnga' gsol shis brjod gnang zhing*/ dbu ma dbon chung gi sku skye rje mchog sprul drung du skra phud 'bul ba dang*/ byang du rdzong ba'i zhal ta gnang*/ rje mchog sprul drung du sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dbang phul/ dhi tsha dpon sogs mchod yon gyis nyi lde dgon dang bkra shis dge 'phel du'ang spyan 'dren zhus/ slar gad mdor phebs/ chos lung mkhan chen mjal du phebs pa dang*/ lho stod nas sde pa mched sogs par mos 'tshams kyi chos bka' ci rigs stsal/ de nas 'brog smad du khri dpon mched kyis lhun rdzong nas zhabs tog zhus shing stod smad kyi ser skya phal mo ches 'bul mchod ches bstar ba'i yon sbyangs shing*/ yar rgyab dpon chen pa mched sogs kyis spyan 'dren rim 'byor bzhin/ rgyal chen gling du phebs te lcags pho rta lo'i lo sar smon lam rgyas par gnang*/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa dpon slob dang*/ dge 'dun sngags grwa ba sogs la bka' chos mang du stsal/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyang mang du gnang*/ mkhan chen kun spangs par zab rgyas kyi dbang chos mang du gnang*/ sde pa hor bsod dar khu dbon gyis 'phyong rgyas su spyan drangs te stag rtse'i gzhis ka gsar bcos la phyag nas zhu ba dang*/ chos bka' mang du gsan zhing bsnyen bkur dpag med bgyis/ 'phags sde'i mkhan por rngog dkyil bdun gyi dbang sogs gnang*/ mchog sprul drung du rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum pusti dang po gnyis kyi lung phul/

sa skyong phun tshogs lcam dral gyis spyan drangs/ khrom sar du gdan phab thog thel nas spyan snga'i dgongs rdzogs su spyan 'dren bzhin thel du phebs/ skyor lung zhabs drung bzhugs par yang bka' chos gnang*/ dgongs rdzogs kyi dbur mdzad cing 'bul bsnyen bla lhag par zhus shing*/ slar yar stod du phebs/ rgyal tshab sprul skus gtsos gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun nyis stong tsam la 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i lung dang*/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid/ chos sgo ba sogs bla 'go rnams la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i dbang*/ nang so mchod sprin pa sogs drung 'khor rags bsdus la zab mo nang don gyi 'grel pa zin thun du gnang ba sogs so so'i mos pa dang 'tshams pa'i theg gsum chos kyi bka' drin ci yang stsal/ chos rgyal pho brang bas dgon gnas dang bu khral phul ba bzhin thar gling gi grwa tshang 'dzugs pa'i bka' khyab kyang mdzad/ zla ba dgu par dwags por gdan btegs/ spung dkar la thog tu sgo lcang gnyis kyi thabs 'dzin dang*/ la rtsar sku rab nas sde pa srong btsan pa khu dbon gyis chibs bsu dang bcas sku rab bkra shis sgang du gdan phab/ sde pa blon 'bangs dgon sde dang bcas pa rnams kyis so so'i 'bul ba bsnyen bkur dpag med bgyis/ zla ba bcu par rje nyid chibs rags nyung bsdus kyis tsā ri yul stod smad kyi gnas gzigs la phebs te brag dkar mo yan chad kyi gnas phran rnams kyang zhib mjal dang*/ gnas kyi lte ba mkha' 'gro 'bum del du tshogs 'khor gyi thog ri pa jo bzang sgar pa dang bcas rnams phag mo'i lha khrid rdzogs par gnang*/ slar bzhugs sgar du phebs nas sde pa zhal ngo sogs du mar so so'i mos pa dang 'tshams pa'i dam pa'i chos sbyin ci yang stsal/ gnas gzhir gandho la'i rten shom dang dge 'dun sde rnams kyis smon lam kyang mdzad/ bcu gnyis par dwags stod la gdan bteg /

sgam po'i gnas mjal/ yom dgon du rin po che rnam grags pas gzhi len dang 'bul ba mdzad/ nang so sgo pas do bo chos rdzong du'ang spyan drangs/ bshad sgrub gling du phebs nas lo mjug sku rim dang lcags mo lug lo'i lo gsar smon lam rnams mdzad cing*/ rje mchog sprul drung nas gzhung lugs rab 'byams la gsan pa gnang ba'i klog pa'i slob dpon du mkhas dbang rin grags pa mnga' gsol/ sgo skur gnyis kas zla ba gsum du zhabs tog zhus te gzhi byes kyi dge tshul slong sgrub pa'ang mang du byung*/ der kong po'i kar srid stod smad thams cad kyis spyan 'dren ja zhus pa rnams dang*/ khams nas mnyan sprul dpon slob rnams kyis ja 'bul sogs sleb/ de nas rab gling dgon par zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gi gter gnas la dang lung khra mo brag gi gnas mjal kyang mdzad nas slar sku rab tu phebs te sde pas gsol btab bzhin gnas gzhi'i tshoms chen du yang zur cog grwa rnams kyis rgyud sde'i dkyil chog mang po'i sgrub mchod 'dzugs pa gnang ste/ nyin re bzhin yab sras tshogs dbur phebs/ de nas kong por chibs bsgyur/ dpal 'byor rtse'i nye logs su mchog sprul drung du rang byung bka' 'bum gyi dkyil chog rnams kyi dbang dang khrid skor lung ci rigs pa mdzad/ la thog zur mkhar du nang so blo gros rgyal po khu mtshan gyis 'bul zhabs dpag tu med pas bsnyen bkur/ zla ba lnga par dung dkar brag tu phebs/ de nas rkyen gnas rang du phebs thog dpon a bo sangs rgyas dang*/ gcen rgyal sogs zhal ngo rnams kyis bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pas sri zhur bgyis shing*/ tsā ri rin phug tu'ang phebs/ de nas mtsho dkar gyi gnas nang du phebs tshe nyi ma gsal zhing dngas pa'i 'khor yug tu 'ja' tshon las grub pa'i bya dang 'brug gi gzugs snang ba dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung*/

slar bkra shis ljongs dang byin legs kyi gnas mjal kyang mdzad/ de nas sle lung du rtul mi g.yu 'brug spun gyis zhag 'ga'i bar bsnyen bkur zhus/ 'or shod du sde pa khag gsum gyis zhabs bsnyen ring mchog sprul drung du skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing dang rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum sgrub thabs skor gyi lung mdzad/ zing po 'bum pa sgang du jo sgam po dang*/ dgongs 'dus pa khu dbon sogs kyis zhabs tog yun du zhus ring*/ mi bskyod zhabs kyi bka' 'bum las dbu phar mdzod rnams kyi 'grel pa'i lung 'bul ba dang*/ sgar chos sde'i drung 'khor dang gra gzhon blo gsal kha yar bsdus nas rje mchog sprul drung du gsan sbyong phyags phyi'i dgongs bzhed ltar 'dzugs pa'i zhal ta dang do dam gnang ste sku gzhog 'og min gling du 'dogs pa gnang*/ bcu gcig par gdan sa dga' ldan ma mor phebs/ 'jang rgyal blon gyi 'bul skyel gtos cher 'byor/ kong lung ral gsum gyi mi dpon lha dpon gyis gtsos pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams 'dus/ chu spre'i lo sar dang smon lam rten shom dang bcas rgyas par gnang zhing*/ zla ba gnyis par bteg rtse lha sgang du phebs/ nang sos gtsos pa'i kar srid rgya 'go dang bcas pas 'bul zhabs dpag med bgyis shing*/ skal pa dang 'tshams pa'i chos sbyin ci rigs su stsal/ der thugs dam rten du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bye ru las grub pa zhig bzhengs par brtsams/

de nas phrag zur gdong gi dge 'dun rgya 'go dang bcas pas spyan 'dren ltar rdzar sgrub sde'ang zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ nags yul spang du gdan phab nas/ dge slong sum brgya tsam gyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig dbyar snga ma zhal gyis bzhes te dbyar gnas mdzad par sde dgon rnams kyis mchod pa dang gus 'byor phun sum tshogs pas bkur sti dang rim gror bgyis shing*/ dgag dbye'i nyin tshogs pa rnams la dwags po'i chos bzhi'i chos kyi dga' ston rgyas par stsal/ rtsa gong ba dang sho kha chos sde so sos spyan 'dren dang*/ rtsa nang gi gnas gzigs dang chos rgya gso ba'i bka' khyab gnang nas/ slar rtse sgang zhol thang du phebs/ rje nyid dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa chu mo bya lo'i lo gsar dang smon lam gnang thog rje gong ma rnams phyag srol ltar rtse sgang pho brang gi mdzod nag zhal phye nas bzhugs sgar du gzim gur karma lha khang 'bubs pa gnang*/ gandho las gtsos pa'i byes mdzod kyi rten bsham rgyas pa dang*/ yab sras bzhugs khri dang sku 'khor gyi las tshan gzabs pas lo gsar gyi phyag mjal bzhes pa/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun lnga brgya lhag par rtse sgang nang so rgya 'og dang bcas pas zhabs tog bgyis te smon lam 'dzugs pa gnang*/ yab sras chibs rags gzabs bsham gyi bkod pas pho brang du phebs te bkra shis gsar mar drung de bzhin gshegs pa la gong ma tā'i ming yun lo rgyal pos phul ba'i ar nag dang tsan dan las grub pa'i gnas bcu bzo khyed can dang gong ma mchod yon gyi si thang sogs mdzod nag gi rten shom rags rim gnang*/ de nas nya'i bar nyin re bzhugs sgar byes mdzod kyi rten mjal dang*/ nyin re bzhin pho brang du mdzod nag gi rten mjal rags pa tsam gnang ba'i tshe kong lung ral gsum la sogs pa'i skye bo stong phrag du ma 'dus pas nyin mtshan du phyag dang bskor ba yig drug 'don pa sogs dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar byed cing*/

khams nas karma gdan sa pa dpon slob sogs dang*/ 'jang rgyal blon sogs kyi grwa rgyun dang 'bul skyel gtos che ba sleb pa rnams kyis 'bul tshan bgrang gis mi langs pa bstar zhing*/ bco lnga'i nyin gso sbyong grol nas dge 'dun snam sbyar can bzhi brgya tsam gyi ser sbreng 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyi bkod pa sogs mig dang yid 'phrog pa'i zlos gar dang bcas/ yab sras nyid kyang phyags bskor du phebs te/ slar gzim gur du phebs pa na dbyar dus ltar 'brug grags pa dang char 'babs pa 'ja' tshon gyi dra bas g.yogs pa sogs skye bo kun snang ba'i go skabs des nyams spro zhing 'gyur bas dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i ston 'khor de dag la mos gus bla lhag tu skyes shing*/ rnam par dkar ba'i dpal yon sgrub pa'i dge tshogs rjes su dran nas gtan du dge ba chos dang bla ma'i yon tan la nges shes gting nas skyes pa sogs mang du byung bar yod do// de dag gi tshe dbus nas sde pa tshag pa rdor rnam pa dang*/ sgom thar ba rang gi dad stobs bcas kyis sngon spyan snga rin po che'i phrin las kyi rgyun lugs ltar kun bzang nags khrod kyi gdan sa bdag gir mdzad dgos kyi zhu nan ltar nang so mchod sprin pa dpon g.yog thel rtsis bzhes su gnang ba de nyid du slar 'khor/ zla ba gnyis par lta ba rgyal 'dzin du phebs/ der 'dus kyi skye bo rnams la zhal mjal byin rlabs chos 'brel sogs kyi bka' drin stsal zhing*/ spo bo'i kar srid stod smad kyi rta 'bul sogs gtos cher sleb/ slar nyang kha'i smad spang sna chu skor bar phebs/ de nas dga' ldan ma mor phebs te/ gzhis byes kyi dad 'dus du mar shangs chos yongs rdzogs kyi ljags lung sogs stsal zhing*/ de nyid kyi mdzod nag zhal 'byed dang rten shom sogs gnang skabs rje mchog gi sprul sku'i bzhugs sgar zho ga nas tshur phebs par rje nyid zhabs bskyod pa'i chibs bsu sogs bsu bkod rgya chen po bcas gtsug lag khang gsar mar gdan phebs nas/

tsan dan dkar po la rgya nag gi bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i gandho la dang mu tig dmar po'i mchod rten sogs mdzod nag gi rten mjal dang*/ gzhe len gyi bsnyen bkur rgya cher zhus shing*/ mchog sprul drung nas kyang sku skyos kyi 'bul nod spams che ba gnang*/ slar phrag yul gyi grwa tshang rgya bdag rnams kyis spyan 'dren ltar phebs/ 'jang rgyal blon gyi gser yig 'gron tshan ches mang ba 'byor/ der shing khyi'i lo'i lo gsar smon lam gnang nas kong smad klu shar du phebs/ mchog sprul drung du rje gong ma'i bka' 'bum las dam chos dgongs gcig 'grel pa sogs pusti du ma'i lung phul/ dwags kong dan 'jags kyi don la rgyal tshab sprul sku sogs la zhal bkod bcas rdzong ba gnang*/ chab dkar gyi gsang rgyal 'dzin sogs su phebs nas/ dgon sde che phra mang dag gi bla ma bsko bzhag dang*/ chab dkar nag gi grwa rgyun bu khral yang sbyor ba mdzad cing*/ rje gong ma'i bka' 'bum gyi lung 'ga' zhig 'bul ba mdzad/ slar rnam thos rir phebs/ sgrub sde bsam 'phel du kun gling pa 'jog pa sogs dar rgyas kyi bka' khyab mdzad/ dwags kong lab gzhi'i 'phro 'jags su spyan 'dren ltar phebs/ dwags kong gtan 'cham gyi gung bzhugs dam bzhag sogs legs par gnang ste dus kyi 'khrugs lang gtan zhir mdzad/ de nas sku rab tu phebs/ sku rab pa khu dbon gyis zhag 'ga'i bar btegs nas bsnyen bkur/ mchog sprul drung du snyan ngag me long gzhung bshad dpang 'grel thog nas 'bul ba mdzad cing*/ rtsom rgyugs kyang gnang*/ dwags stod du btegs nas bshad sgrub gling du gdan phab ste lo mjug sku rim dang shing mo phag lo'i lo gsar smon lam rnams gnang*/ smon lam grol nyin ston pa'i sku 'bag grong khyer ma'i 'khor du gnas bcu 'khor yan lag dang bcas pa rnams kyi bkod pa dge 'dun gzhi byes kyi ser sbreng dang bcas pa'i shis brjod rgyas par mdzad/

nang so karma srid bral bas sgo rab brtan gling gi gtsug lag khang rten brten bcas grub pa'i rab gnas su'ang spyan drangs nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas rab tu gnas par mdzad/ dge 'dun rnams kyis smon lam zhag sprel bcas mdzad/ chos ston dang 'bul bsnyen rgya cher bsgrubs shing*/ lcang ra bas kyang mkhar thog tu 'bul ba bsnyen bkur zhus/ slar bshad sgrub gling du gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshogs cher bka' gdams glegs bam lung dang*/ byang chub spyod 'jug gi ljags bshad sogs stsal/ gzhan yang so so'i 'dod chos kyi dbang bka' khrid lung mang po dang*/ dge 'dun bshad sgrub gling par sger du dus 'khor gyi dbang dang mngon dkyil par du sgrub pa'i par yig zhus dag sogs mdzad/ de nyid kyi cho ga 'dzugs pa'i zhal ta gnang*/ mnyan sprul dang lcags mo nang so gshegs rdzong sogs kyi 'bul skyel sleb/ gtsang nas kre chung sku skye byon par bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ brgyad par dbus su btegs/ bsam sder phebs thog rje dpa' bo'i sprul sku dge 'dun gyi 'khor bcas pas mjal/ khrom sar du zhal ngo sgar gzhung gi 'bul zhabs cher zhus/ dge 'dun yang ri'i tshogs gur du rje dpa' bo sprul pa'i sku rab tu phyungs te mtshan gtsug lag rgya mtsho dga' ba'i dbyangs su gsol/ gzhan yang spyi sgos su bka' chos ci rigs pa gnang*/ dpa' bo sprul sku dpon slob la rgyud 'bum lung gi dbu tshugs/ bcu gcig par 'bras spungs sprul sku zhal snga nas bsod nams rgya mtsho dang sde pa lha skur mchod yon bka' gros steng nas yar klungs su rtse 'phyong rgyas gnyis kyi chings 'jags la spyan 'dren byung ba bzhin yab sras lhan rgyas kyis tsan thang du phebs te/ 'bras spungs pa dpon slob bzang mo chu bkor du bzhugs pas sna len gyi ston mo dang 'bul dpangs bstod pa mdzad/ der kho rang yon mchod rnams dang yang bka' gros su bstun nas rtse 'phyong rgyas sogs dbus phyogs tshang mar chings khra gnang*/

thar gling grwa tshang gi gtsug lag khang dang rten gsar bzhengs kyi rab gnas mdzad/ khrom sar phebs nas me byi'i lo gsar dang lhun sgang du rten shom smon lam rgyas pa gnang*/ nyid kyi dbon a bo 'brug 'das pa'i byang zhus dang*/ chos sde kun la mang skol tshogs 'gyed sogs rjes sgrub kyi bka' khyab mdzad/ 'jang rgyal blon gyi gser yig spo 'bor ba'i 'gron tshan 'ja' mo bla ma sogs 'bul skyel mang du 'byor/ yar klungs su btegs/ sne'u gdong rtser gdung brgyud rin po ches khra 'brug nas bsu ba'i bkod chen gyis spyan drangs te bka' dbang gsan pa sogs dang gus mchod cher mdzad/ de sngon du 'brong bu sku mched byon/ chos khri chen mor rtse thang pa sogs mchod yon gyis 'bul bsnyen dpangs ches bstod cing*/ bzhugs sgar khag nas kyang tshogs par ja gser gyi 'gyed dang*/ khong rang tsho'i 'dod pa bzhin chos sde chen po'i phyi rgya'i bdag gnyer sgar chen gyis gnang rgyu sogs lugs gnyis kyi brtse skyong tshad med pa gnang*/ zla ba bzhi par gdan sa dpal gyi phag grur gdan phebs shing*/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin bder gshegs phag mo gru pa'i seng khrir zhabs zung bkod pa la/ rje mchog sprul ka phebs steng du khri'u'i shing dbu gdugs dang bcas phebs te bkra shis mnga' gsol 'bul ba dang legs ja'i gnang skyes gya nom pa mdzad/ sgar phyi nang dang dbus gtsang dwags kong yan gyi bla dpon sde ris che phra kun gyis zhal dkar legs ja'i 'bul ba sogs chos ldan gyi dga' ston bla lhag tu bgyis shing*/ zung mang chos rje padma blo gros sku skye 'bul skyel spoms che ba dang bcas 'byor/ yangs can nas dbon gu shri dpon g.yog phebs pa dang bcas phyag mdzod gzhi byes nas kyang thel ri dgon rnams la khri phebs sku skyos kyi mang ja dang*/ 'gyed chen/ rten gsum rnams kyi snyan dar/ mkhan slob rnams la rnam bzhag

/dar po che gsar brje/ chos skyong gi rten 'dzugs sogs rgyas par gnang*/ rje mchog gi sprul skus dbu mdzad sgar chos sde dang bcas pa'i drag 'gos rnams la yang legs ja skyes lan gyi bur ston dang 'bul gnang rgya cher stsal/ de nas rim pas gtsug lag khang steng shod phyi nang kun gyi rten gsum spyan gzigs mchod rdzas rnams la gzigs rtog dang deb bsdur mdzad/ de skabs rnams su mchog sprul drung du phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor nyams khrid du 'bul ba dang*/ 'og min gling grwa tshang du bzhugs rgyu'i mgon sku bzhengs gnang la zhal bkod dang phyag bzo'ang ci rigs pa gnang*/ der gtsang phyogs su dus gzings langs pas/ rin spungs pa dang sde pa zhing gnyis ka nas bzhugs sgar spyan 'dren bstud mar sleb pas rje mchog sprul gtsang phyogs su sngon la chibs bsgyur/ rje nyid gdan sa'i zhal ta bslab ston la re zhig rjes su bzhugs nas zhing stod smad kyi 'thus btsun bzhi bcu rtsa grangs la gzhi mdzad pa'i thel du bka' brgyud mdzes rgyan gling gi grwa tshang 'dzugs pa mdzad cing*/ nang so sgo pas smon grong yang dge 'dun gyi cha rkyen du phul/ rje dpa' bo'i sprul sku dang*/ si tu sprul sku chos kyi rgyal mtshan pas gtsos pa'i gzhi byes kyi 'dus pa tshogs che ba la rdor phreng dbang bka' la sogs pa'i spyi chos sger chos so so'i mos pa dang 'tshams pa du ma gnang bas gnyug mar gnas pa dang glo bur lhags pa'i skye tshogs ji snyed pa yang dag pa'i lam la dkri bar mdzad de/ dgu pa'i tshes lngar gdan bteg /brag khar sde pa tshag pa rdor rnam pas 'bul bsnyan rgya cher bstabs/ de nas byang kha brgyud/ mchims phu dang bsam yas mthil gyi gnas rten rnams zhib mjal mchod 'bul smon lam sogs mdzad de sngags grwa rgyal byed tshal du phebs pa na/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po dang zhal ngo yum sras mchod yon rnams mjal du 'byor/

dge 'dun rnams la tshe dbang sogs kyi 'dod chos dang spyi rdzas kyi cha rkyen mang du stsal/ phreng po bas kyang sna len gyi 'bul zhabs dang*/ lum par gangs dkar nas zhabs drung khu dbon las chan gzabs shom gyi bkod pas phebs te bsnyen bkur dang 'bul dpangs ches bstod/ shel grong du smyug la bas thab 'dzin bgyis/ chos grwa chen po zul phur phebs te/ dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbreng sogs kyis bsu ba dang 'bul bsnyen yang dag bgyis/ sgar mang rnam rgyal sgang du phab nas/ chibs rags lha sar jo mjal la phebs pas lha sa gzigs mtshams nas bzung ba'i phebs lam thog thag tu me tog gi char 'bab pa chibs rags pa phal gyis mthong ba'i ltas ngo mtshar ba dang bcas gtsug lag khang du phebs nas jo bo rin po che'i drung du thugs kyi mos pa rgya chen pos brgya phyag dang sku la gser sil ma mang du 'thor ba mdzad cing*/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ na bza' sogs kyi mchod pa dang smon lam yun ring por mdzad/ gzhan yang jo bo bcu gcig zhal la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang steng shod ra mo che dang bcas rnams su'ang phyag mchod smon lam dang*/ ser 'bras kyi dge 'dun rnams la mang ja 'gyed bcas gya nom pa gnang*/ der skyi shod pa'i dpon sa stag lung nas kyis ja bur gyi ston mo dang*/ 'bul ba spoms che ba mdzad nas khong rang gi nyag thag dang thod kyi gser g.yu mu tig phal mo che jo bo bcu gcig zhal gyi sku rgyan du 'bul bar rje nyid kyi drung du dam 'cha' zhing*/ spyan lam du bstar/ gzhis ka sne'ur yar rgyab nas sde pa sku 'bring pa dpon g.yog gi zhabs tog dang*/ bang ra mo cher shun zhabs drung gis gsol thab bteg nas chos ston dang 'bul nod yang dag mdzad thog sgar chen nas spyan 'dren zhabs bskul ba 'byor/ de nas dbon kar bstan pas lum pa'i chos rdzong grub pa la shis brjod phyag nas gnang ste bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis la stod klung bde chen dang tshes bcu bzhir yangs can dgon du phebs/

dbon gu shri kar bstan pas gzhi len gyi bsnyen bkur dang*/ li dmar las rgya gar yul dbus kyi bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i thub dbang sku brnyan sngon chos rgyal gyi dus yer pa'i ra bar bzhugs pas thub pa rab mar grags pa dang gur mgon gyi lcags sku rgya nag mas gtsos pa'i 'bul chen bgyis/ me glang lo gsar dang smon lam gnang zhing*/ de thog lha sar jo bo shākya mu ni'i drung du 'phan mgo dngul srang chen bco lnga re dang*/ ma gser zho brgya nyi shu re las brdungs pa'i gser 'phan rin po che'i za ra tshags kyis spras pa cha dang*/ jo bo bcu gcig zhal la mu tig sogs rin po che sna tshogs pa'i mgul rgyan dang stod g.yogs 'bul ba gnang*/ sgar chen nas lo gsar 'bul ba dang*/ spyan 'dren zhabs bskul gnyis pa'ang 'byor/ yangs can mkhan po dang*/ gnas nang grwa tshang gi slob dpon dag bsko bzhag mdzad nas/ bsil sna nas gdan bteg /hor stod pa'i dpon dmangs bcas pas 'bul zhabs dang*/ g.yag sde brgyud/ sa skyong ngag dbang 'jig dbang pas bsu bkod rgya chen po dang bcas te ra lnga'i klu sdings su phebs/ rin spungs gzhis kar spyan drangs te pho brang chen po bzo bcos mdzad pa la dpal sdom pa lha lnga'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa dang mtha' rgyas kyi sbyin sreg /pho brang steng nas phyogs mtshams su rdo rje rnam 'joms gzungs chus bsangs gtor sogs shis pa'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad cing*/ mi'i dbang pos dga' ston gyi bsnyen bkur dang 'bul chen tshad med pa bgyis/ der sgar chen nas ja zhus zhabs bskul 'byor bzhin gdan bteg /gtsang gzhung brgyud dbang rtser phebs thog rje mchog sprul drung nas bstan pa spyi sgos kyi gces spras la dgongs pa'i bca' yig gnang 'dug ltar/ tshul bzhin gnas dgos pa'i bka' stsal yang phebs/

nyer bzhi'i nyin sgar chen gyi grag 'gos rnams dang sde pa zhing mchod yon gyis chibs bsu thab 'dzin dang*/ chos sde gzhi byes rnams ser sbreng gzabs rgyas/ rje mchog sprul zhal snga nas nyid kyang sgar gyi phyir zhabs bsur phebs nas shangs rnam gling gi cog ro na khar yab sras gdan 'dzom pa mdzad/ rje dpa' bo sprul skus thog drangs pa'i don gnyer du mar rgyud 'bum gyi lung 'phro mus sogs spyi chos sger chos dpag tu med pa gnang*/ gsung rab gling gi lha chen gzungs gzhug la skyon zhugs tshul zhus bzhin karma srid bral ba la gzungs gzhug 'bul skyor bgyid par stsal/ rje mchog sprul drung nas mgon sku gsar bzhengs kyi rab gnas las bzhi'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil chog sgo nas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg tshe thab kyi khyon dang bud shing gi ltos la rags ma las pa'i me lce gser gyi kha dog lta bu du ba mi dku zhing gsal la dngas pa dpag bsam gyi ljon pa ltar 'du khang gi rgya mthongs la reg pa tsam du yun ring 'bar ba'i me pra shin tu legs pa ngo mtshar ba'ang byung*/ der stod nas lo chen sku skye dang khams nas dpon bzhag bla'i sku skye 'jang rgyal blon mchod yon gyi 'bul skyel 'gron tshan che ba/ lho rong gu'i shri gshegs pa'i bsngo smon zhu mi gling du si dpon g.yog sogs rim par 'byor pa'i 'bul chen grangs mang dang*/ sde pa zhing gis kyang brgya 'bul 'gos che ba sogs bsnyen bkur dpag med bgyis/ yab sras chibs rags nyung bsdus kyis rin spungs su phebs/ rje nyid pa rnam du'ang phebs pas yul phyogs de dag pha rol gyi dmag dpung gi nyer 'tshe dang bral bar mdzad cing stag gru khar zhal rgyas nas rong gtsang gi chings khra gnang ste dus kyi 'khrug lang rgyun chad par mdzad/ lha phu bas spyan drangs ltar lha phu rin gling du phebs te de thog nas 'bras spungs chos rje sog yul du 'byon pa'i rdzongs kyi gnang skyes la spyan snga ba dpon g.yog mngags pa gnang zhing*/

sa pho stag lo'i lo gsar smon lam rten shoms dang bcas pa gnang nas/ sos 'go sne skor thang du sgar spos gnang thog sog po bo shan pagshi sogs 'byor bas gser dngul gos dar rnga mo sogs kyi 'bul chen bgyis te bsnyen gnas dang yig drug gi bzlas lung sogs pa'i bka' drin zhus/ dkar po brag gi grwa tshang 'go 'dzugs kyi skabs sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun la bde mchog dang mgon po'i bka' dbang stsal/ slar sde pa zhing gis bsam rtser spyan drangs nas bzhugs skabs/ sde pa snar thang bas sngon gyi bag chags sad pa lta bu'i mi phyed pa'i dad mos kyis chos grwa chen mo snar thang du spyan drangs te/ dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa sogs nod/ phyir bzhugs sgar du phebs nas hor stod smad kyi spyan 'dren nan chags sleb/ lha phur pheb thog sgar chen gyi phyag mdzod pa'i go sar rje dbon kar rig pa brko ba gnang shing jo mo gangs kyi gnas gzigs dang bstun shu gu la nas gnam khog brgyud/ rim pas 'dam ko khyim du phebs/ hor karma dpal dpon tshang sde dmangs dang bcas pas 'bul mchod rgya chen po'i bsnyen bkur rgyun chags su bgyis shing*/ skye bo du ma la zhal mjal gsung thos kyi 'brel pa sogs kyis dge ba'i rgyu la sbyor bar mdzad nas/ zla ba brgyad par yab sras chibs rags ra sgreng du phebs te/ phyag mchod smon lam dang dge 'dun rnams la mang ja 'gyed bcas kyang gnang*/ slar ko khyim du phebs nas dgu par bteg /gnam khog brgyud/ bye lung du dge bshes ston pa dang*/ dpal mkha' spyod pa sogs 'khrungs gnas dang*/ rtsa sgye mo rnams kyi gnas gzigs mdzad/ bde chen du thogs shig bzhugs nas zhar du lum pa rdzong du rten gtor 'dzugs pa gnang*/ mtshur phur phebs te/ sa mo yos lo'i lo gsar dang*/ dbon kar bstan pas bde chen nas thab chen bteg nas zhabs tog bgyis te gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshogs che bas smon lam btsugs/

cho 'phrul gyi dus chen la 'du khang chen mor gandho la dang*/ gzhan yang ston pa'i sku li ma khyad can du ma'i rten shom rgyas pa gnang ba'i drung du rje nyid kyis mkhan po dang*/ rgyal tshab sprul sku las slob/ mkhas dbang rnam grags pa dang*/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang gi mkhan chen sogs mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang las rje mchog sprul bsnyen par rdzogs pa gnang ste/ rje mchog sprul nas mkhan po'i drung du bka' drin gyi yon shel dang gser dngul gyi spyad cha/ ja gos dar/ na bza' skor sogs dngos gtsang gi sna grangs sum brgya'i 'bul nod dang*/ las grwal ba sogs dge 'dun spyi la'ang mang ja rnam bzhag rgyas pa bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dga' ston du stsal zhing*/ rje nyid nas kyang mchog sprul drung du rgyal ba rigs lnga ston pa dang bcas gos sku thog tshad ma drug gis thog drangs legs ja'i 'bul ba rgya che ba mdzad/ de skabs dpon bzhag bla'i sku skye sogs gzhan yang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang du gnang*/ 'jang rgyal blon gyi gser yig 'gron tshan/ byang nas hor dpon sogs mtha'i skye bo'ang mang du 'dus/ bco lnga'i nyin gso sbyong dang yab sras mgon du phebs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi ser sbreng rgyal srid sna bdun gyi zlos gar sogs bcas pas gling bskor mdzad de/ gtsug lag khang mdun nas shis brjod rgyas par mdzad/ shun zhabs drung yang mjal phyag tu phebs/ zla ba gnyis par rje mchog sprul/ rje dpa' bo sprul sku sogs zhabs 'breng ba bcas rnams la 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i ljags lung dbu tshugs/ de nyid kyi nyer lnga la yangs can du sgrub mchod gral dbur mchog sprul rin po che chibs rags gzabs rgyas kyis chibs skyel bcas skor tsam phebs/ slar mtshur phur phebs bsu dang*/ gzhi byes dge 'dun gyi ser sbreng*/ bkra shis khra ring rkyong ba/ mchog sprul rin po che nyid zhabs bsur phebs pa bcas bkur sti chen pos bla ma lha khang du yab sras zhal rgyas/

gzhung nas sna len gyi bur ston zhu ba sogs mdzad/ 'du khang 'khrungs brgya sogs logs bris gnang ba'i zhal bkod mdzad/ mchog sprul nas dngul sku sar bzhengs la rab gnas gnang*/ dbon gu'i shri kar bstan pa la mchod khang gong zhig gsos zhal ta'ang gnang*/ de dag gi skabs drung rol pa'i rdo rje'i bka' 'bum lung sogs phul/ zur mang che tshang gis thog drangs pa'i bla mgo mang po'i 'bul ba gtos che ba dang bcas 'byor/ zla ba drug par lhan rgyas hor stod pas gnam mtsho khar spyan drangs nas dpon khag sde tshan so sos 'bul bsnyen chen po rgyun ring du bgyis shing*/ ston pa'i dngul sku dang*/ gsung rab kha yar sar bzhengs la rab gnas dang*/ byang ris kyi skye bo ser skya mchog dman kun la zhal mjal gsung thos la sogs pa'i 'brel pas mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam du 'god par mdzad/ zla ba brgyad par mtshur phur phebs/ rje mchog sprul drung du nā ro chos drug nyams khrid du 'bul ba dang*/ 'du khang logs bris grub pa'i zhal byang skyes rabs don bsdus thugs rtsom gnang*/ dgu par mtshur yangs gnas nang gi dge 'dun khag gsum gyis so sor dkyil chog gsum/ sgar chos sde'i dge 'dun gyis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga bgyis pa rnams kyis rdo rje slob dpon du phebs pas/ logs bris dang ston pa gtso 'khor gyi sku 'bag /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sman sku/ ma mgon mgar gsum gyi 'chams sku sogs sar bzhengs rnams la rab gnas zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi sbyin sreg dang bcas gnang ba'i dga' ston gyi tshe rje mchog sprul rin po che'i drung du legs ja'i 'bul mchod spoms che ba'ang mdzad/ sku 'bag sogs gsar bzhengs rnams spyan drangs nas yab sras zhabs bskyod pa'i dge 'dun gyis ser sbreng shis brjod kyi mtha' rgyas bcas mdzad/ de nas mchog sprul drung dang rje dpa' bo sprul sku dpon slob rnam par/

drung de bzhin gshegs pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ dpal mkha' spyod pa rnams kyi bka' 'bum dang*/ bka' gdams glegs bam dang*/ 'bri khung zab chos rnams kyi lung 'bul ba dang*/ gzim chung po ṭa lar rab gnas dang mchod khang rtser bzhugs rgyu'i dngul sku rdo rje 'chang bzhengs pa'i rgyu byin rlabs sogs kyang mdzad/ kong stod smad kyi rta 'bul mang po dang*/ drung spungs ri ba byon te bsnyen par rdzogs/ sog yul nas 'bras spungs chos rje'i zhu 'phrin dang ja zhus 'bul ba 'byor/ bcu gnyis par gnas nang byams khang gi dbu rtse dang khyams gzabs bcos bgyis pa dang bgyid par stsal ba'i gzigs rtog dang zhal bkod la skor tsam phebs/ slar mtshur phur phebs nas lcags pho 'brug lo'i lo gsar smon lam gnang*/ stag lung dpon sa mjal du byon nas brgya 'bul mdzad/ zur mang sku skye che tshang bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas zla ba gnyis pa la mchog sprul drung du o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi lung phul ba'i dbu tshugs shing*/ 'jang rgyal pos spyan 'dran 'bul skyel rnams 'byor/ zla ba de nyid kyi nyer gsum nyin skor lam du zhabs 'chag la phebs te mchod khang gong gi chu mig khar bzhugs stan 'og tu rdo khri dang rdo gcal gyis gsungs bzhin byas par rgyang tsam bzhugs nas bsam spro spro ltar mdzad de slar gtsug lag khang du phebs skabs sogs la sngar dang mi 'dra bar sku ngal nyams yod pa dang nyer lnga nas chab gzhi la brten pa'i sku mnyel tshul bstan pa zhig byung bar rje mchog sprul drung gi dbu mdzad sgar chos sde sogs gzhi byes thams cad kyis brtan bzhugs 'bul ba dang*/ sku rim dar drag tu bsgrubs shing*/ phyag rang nas kyang bla g.ye nub kyi bzhugs khri chen mor rje mchog sprul tshogs dbur phebs pa'i gnas nang yan gyi gzhi byes tshang mar mang ja dang tshogs 'gyed mchog sprul drung du sa le sbram rdog po re la yang zho gnyis gsum las mi nyung ba yod pa'i brgya phreng dang chibs cang shes sogs spong dag gi rnam pa'i 'bul ba dang 'gyed bcas gya nom pa'ang stsal/

da res ti se la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su mchod pa zhig 'bul dgos gsungs nas/ sngar yol sgo ba dge slong karma brtson 'grus kyis ti se'i gnas mjal du dgongs zhus skabs 'di lta'i bka' lung mdzad ltar mchod pa dang sbrags nas mngags pa mdzad/ de ltar brtan bzhugs dang sku rim gsol sman gyi 'phrod brten phul ba rnams dmigs su song bas sku khams rim gyis gzhi med du dngas te zla ba bzhi par mjal kha rnams gnang*/ rje mchog sprul drung nas bsnyun dngas dgyes spro'i 'bul ba spom che ba dang*/ 'dus tshogs kun nas dga' ston gyi bsnyun dngas phul/ de nas lha rje rnams kyis zhu ngo bzhin gnang nas yum rdzong du chab brje ba la phebs te zla ba gcig nye bar bzhugs nas/ sde pa dang yul mi rnams kyis 'bul chen bgyis/ gnas nang du yar phebs shing drug par yar rgyab nas sde pa dpon chen ba mched rnams gnas dang yab sras mjal bar byon nas 'bul bsnyen rgya cher zhus/ bdun par byams khang rtse'i bla ma lha khang tshags su grub pa'i rab gnas tshugs/ de skabs mu tig gi mchod rten bum nang du byang chub kyi shing la rje nyid rang gis phyag bzo gnang ba'i ston pa'i sku dang*/ rje karma pa na rim dgu'i dbu lo bzhugs pa zhig kyang bzhengs pa gnang*/ de nas hor stod smad kyi dpon rnams kyis yab sras byang du spyan 'dren gyi pho nya rim 'byor bzhin/ de nyid kyi tshes bcur gnas nang nas gdan bteg bcu gcig gi nyin rang byung rje'i sgrub gnas skyer gcig gi mdor yab sras zhal rgyas nas yangs can nas brgyud byang la chibs bsgyur/ 'dam ko khyim du phebs tshe ma tshor ba gcig la 'dir jag pa sleng zhes gsung sgra chen po zhig sgar pa kun gyis thos zer/ der re zhig nas sde dmangs kyi 'bul zhabs rags pa tsam grub skabs sog po'i jag 'khyar bas rdzi bo'i sa nas chibs drel kha shas ded song bar/

sgar pas bzlog pa dang gtor rgyag sogs btsugs pa la/ cog grwa bar phyag ja gnang nas khyed rang tshos bzlog pa ma 'don par tshe gzungs dang bsngo smon gang 'gro thon gsungs pa'i bka' ched gtad du stsal/ de nas dkar po sgor dpon tshang gis brgya 'bul gtos che ba bgyis/ rim pas slar yangs can du phebs nas dge 'dun rnams la sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu'i tshogs chos gnang*/ de nas yab sras mtshur gnas so sor sngon bzhin gdan phebs nas/ bcu pa phyi mar rje nyid kyang chibs bsu la phebs pa'i dge 'dun gzhi byes gyi ser sbreng dar cha rol mo la sogs pa'i bsu bkod rgya chen pos rje mchog sprul mtshur phu nas spyan 'dren mdzad de/ byams khang gi sgo khang logs bris kyi rab gnas gnang zhing gzhi len gyi bsnyen bkur 'bul dpangs bstod pa dang*/ rje mchog sprul drung nas kyang legs ja'i gnang skyes gzabs pa mdzad/ slar zhal rgyas kyi dga' grong du phebs nas chos gzhis pa dang shun zhabs drung yan phyin lugs legs kyi bka' gnang stsal/ de skabs su gdan thel dang 'bri stag rnams kyi spyan 'dren zhu nan rim 'byor stabs/ zla ba bcu gcig par dga' grong nas rje mchog gi sprul skus chibs skyel kyi lhan rgyas bcas lum pa zab gdong du bzhugs/ de nas stod klung brgyud stag lung du chos rjes gtsos pa'i bsu bkod gling pa bcas dpon slob kun nas 'bul mchod rgya cher mdzad/ chos rje khu dbon la bka' chos dang gnas bcu'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas/ gling pa kun la'ang spyi sgos kyi 'dod chos ci rigs bka' drin stsal/ de nas klungs shod brgyud/ 'bri khung bas mal gror spyan drangs te khang thog gnyis ka nas bsnyen bkur zhabs 'degs dpag med mdzad de khri rin po che sras yum rnams la nyin re bzhin dbang bka' gnang zhing*/ spro lung nas chos rje rin po che yang mjal du phebs/

ri che'i chos rje pad rgyal sprul sku karma grags rnam pa zhabs phyir bzhugs mu las che 'don dang bcas khams su brdzangs gnang*/ rim pas rgyal bzang du phebs pa na sde pa tshag pa rdong rnam pas sde srid kyi bla rten rgya nag rgyal po'i bsod nams kyis rgya mtsho'i gling nas rnyed pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rdo sku rang byon gyis thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba'i dpangs cher bstod/ zla ba bcu gnyis par thel du phebs nas dus rim dang lcags mo sbrul lo'i lo gsar dang smon lam thog khyams su gzhi byes gyi rten shom rgyas pa zhig gnang bar ka bzhi steng nas ston pa'i tshems spyan 'dren pa'i tshe/ khyams su phebs nas phyag tu spos reng bsnams te/ bsu ba mdzad pa la sogs pa'i gus pa dang mchod pa dang bkur sti bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ rtse tshogs chen pa'i mkhan por gnas brtan byang bzang 'khod pa'i legs ja shis brjod gnang*/ yar rgyab nas yum sras sku mched rnams kyis byams gling dang dol du spyan drangs te mi phyed pa'i dad pas kun nas blangs pa'i 'bul bsnyen mkhos su phebs pa zhus shing*/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang gi mkhan por gnas brtan rin shes pa 'khod par legs ja shis brjod dang*/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshogs cher zab mo nang don gyi bshad pa/ chos drug gi dmigs rim dang bcas pa'i bka' chos gnang*/ dol du'ang rje dpa' bo'i sprul skur bka' 'gyur las sher phyogs skor gyi lung dang dge 'dun chos rdzong pa sogs la'ang so so'i 'dod chos mos pa ji lta bar gnang zhing*/ thub pa chu lon ma dang rnam sras 'jang yul ma'i 'dra shus kyi bris sku'ang bzhengs pa mdzad/ phyir lam dge 'dun sngags grwa ba'i dgon grwa phyi thar gling du phebs sh-ing*/ gtsug lag khang sar bzhengs la phyag nas gnang ste/ lnga par thar ma lcang gseb tu bzhugs sgar gnang nas dpa' bo sprul sku dpon slob la bka' 'gyur 'phro mus sogs kyi bka' chos smar ba gnang*/

dus mkhyen sogs kyi sgrub gnas tig po'i gnas gzigs la phebs/ yar stod nas spyan 'dren rim par 'byor pas/ drug par thel du skor tsam phebs nas grwa tshang gi kun ra gsar rgyag gi sa yul zhabs kyis bcags pa sogs mdzad de/ brag kha yang dgon du sde pa tshag pas zhabs tog 'bul bas zhag 'gar bteg

de nas yar klungs su phebs nyin rtse zhabs drung dpon blon las tshan gzabs shom gyis thab bsu bcas khra 'brug na khar bzhugs sgar gnang*/ rtser spyan drangs te 'bul zhabs dpangs bstod pa dang bka' dbang gsan pa sogs mdzad/ ha la sgang du sde pa'i bsu ba dang*/ g.yam bzang dga' tshal pa sogs kyi bsu ba ser sbreng dang bcas khrom sar gdan phebs te sde pa gzhung nas bsnyen bkur te/ sde pa dang dge 'dun gzhi byes rnams la so so'i mos pa bzhin bka' chos mang du gnang*/ de nas rnam rgyal sgang du dpon sa chos mdzad mas sger du spyan drangs te bzhugs skabs gangs nub dang shar g.yu mtsho'i gnas gzigs la phebs shing*/ g.yam bzang bas kyang dbyar mchod la spyan drangs/ de skabs rje dpa' bo sprul sku dpon slob dang*/ dpon sa mchod yon la mi tra khrid drug gi dbang lung rnams rdzogs par gnang*/ slar sde pa gzhung gis zhabs tog zhus te khrom sar du bzhugs skabs nyin mo'i bzhugs yul rje karma pa'i sprul sku'i gzim khang du gnang tshe sku gsung thugs la bstod pa'i gsol 'debs snyan dngags bya dka'i sbyor ba mdzad nas gyang logs la sbyar ba mdzad/ der sgar chen nas mtshur phu'i mchod gong gi gzabs bcos dang rten gsar bzhengs rnams grub pa'i rab gnas su spyan 'dren pa 'byor bas/ zla ba bcu gcig par bteg byang thang du phebs thog gong dkar zhabs drung khu dbon rnams las tshan gzabs par bcas mjal bar phebs shing bsnyen bkur bla na med pa zhus/ smyug lar legs bshad gling pa dang smyug la ba mchod yon gyis 'bul mchod cher spros/ chu shul du sgar chen gyi ja 'dren dang drag sprel rnams kyis bsu bas mtshur phur phebs thog kyang*/ rgyal tshab sprul sku dang mtshur phu rin po che sogs gtsos pa'i chibs bsu thab 'dzin dge 'dun khag thams cad kyis ser sbreng dang ma mgon kyi 'chams sku spyan 'dren pa dang*/

bkra shis khra ring rkyong ba/ rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyang seng ge sgo mdun du phebs pa sogs kyi bsu bkod rgya chen po dang bcas 'du khang chen mor gdan 'dzoms pa la sku skyos kyi tshul du 'bul dpangs ches cher bstod/ de ma thag sku rim chen mo'i gral dbur phebs/ rje mchog sprul sku zhabs su gzhung nas gzhi len gyi gsol dro bur ston gzabs pa zhus/ chu pho rta lo'i lo gsar smon lam gyi thog nas/ mtshur gnas nang yangs can pa'i dge 'dun rags bsdus sogs kyi gsang 'dus dus 'khor la sogs pa'i chog grwa dang*/ rje nyid gral dbur bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun zur ri'i cog gra'i bde mchog pa rnams nas mchod gong steng shod rten brten pa dang bcas pa'i rab gnas gnang ba'i dga' ston tshe rdo rje slob dpon gyi yon du rje mchog sprul drung nas gser sil ma zho brgya/ dngul srang chen brgyas gtsos pa'i 'bul tshan dngos gtsang ba grangs mang mdzad cing*/ phar yang gtsug lag khang grub pa'i legs ja dpangs bstod pa mdzad/ de dag gi tshe khams nas tsher lung sku skye dpon slob rnams 'bul skyel dang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub slad du 'byor/ der 'bri khung khang thog nang 'khrogs pa'i dums la sgar pa gdan 'dren byung bar/ nang so mdo rgyud dpon g.yog snga 'gros su btang*/ de nas bde chen nas brgyud yangs can du gdan phab ste/ rje dpa' bo sprul skus gtsos dge 'dun tshogs che ba la mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang bka' rnams rdzogs par gnang*/ 'bri khung du nang sos re zhig bar ching thon nas phebs ma dgos/ slar gnas nang du phebs/ byams khang khyams kyi logs bris kyi mgo 'dzugs gnang nas zhal bkod mdzad/ sde pa thub rgyal bas spang gshongs ha ri kha pa rnams la sngar gyi chos rgyun gso bar bsam pas grwa pa rgan po phal cher zhang gi bka' rgya chos skor rnams zhu bar zhu phrin bcas drung du brdzangs par bka' rgya'i skor gyi ljags lung sogs gzhi byes kyi chos don gnyer rnams la bka' chos mang du gnang*/

drug par logs bris rnams grub par dge 'dun cog grwa pa rnams kyis cho ga'i phyags phyi bgyis te dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa gnang ba'i dngos gzhi nyin rje mchog sprul/ rje nyid chibs bsur phebs ba'i ser sbreng sogs bsu bkod rgya chen pos spyan drangs te/ 'du khang du gdan 'dzom nas phyag nas dang dga' ston mdzad/ yar stod lcam chos mdzad mas tshogs 'khor gzabs shoms dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs kyi 'bul skyel mang pos 'bul tshan bstar zhing*/ slar rje mchog sprul mtshur phur yar phebs/ de nas zla ba bdun pa'i mthar lhan rgyas lho brag phyogs su phebs/ sgor shar bzhin gdan btegs/ bzang smyug dpal de sogs brgyud/ so so nas zhabs bsnyen zhu rim bzhin/ zha mdar byang bdag po rig sngags 'chang ba bkra shis stobs rgyas pa mjal 'bul du phyags 'byor/ mkha' ro'i gnas gzigs gnang nas/ lho stod sde dgon gyis bsu ba'i bkod pa dang bcas mon thang gnas su gdan phebs te/ mkhos su phebs pa'i bsnyen bkur bzang pos bteg cing*/ mchog sprul drung du o rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi 'phro mus dang*/ zhang gi bka' 'bum/ khro phu brgya rtsa/ yang dgon bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung phul/ zla ba dgu par sras mkhar dgyes rdor gtsug lag khang du gdan phebs nas mchog sprul drung du sku gsum ngo sprod nyams khrid kyi tshul du 'bul ba dang*/ stong la 'du khang chen mor gzhi byes kyi dge slong gi dge 'dun grangs mang gi tshogs su lhan rgyas kyis phebs te gso sbyong gnang zhing*/ lho brag grwa tshang ba rnams la grub chen pakshi'i zab chos rgya mtsho mtha' yas kyi bshad pa dang dmigs rim gnang*/ de skabs sngon spyan snga rin po che mon du phebs nas bum thang du dgon gsar 'debs mdzad de/ lhun grub chos sdings su 'dogs pa gnang ba'i bla ma dhi tsha'i dbon dang*/ bum thang pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis spyan 'dren gyi gsol ba nan cher btab pas/

sngar rje gong mas mtha' 'khob btul ba'i zhing mus su 'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas zla ba bcu par mon la chibs bsgyur/ lhun grub chos sdings su phebs nas/ gzhi byes kyi skya ser la mi bskyod rdo rje'i mos gus bdun ma'i khrid skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang sbyar ba'i tshogs chos dang*/ mtha' 'khob tu sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel la dgongs te bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong kyang gnang*/ de nas mon rgyal mkhar nas uu ra phyin zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ bum thang mthil du'ang phebs nas slob dpon padma'i sku rjes brag gi gnas mjal dang*/ phyug po chu skor ba sogs kyi 'bul zhabs bzhes te/ slar lhun grub chos sdings nyid du phebs pa na/ mon phu mda' bar gsum gyi skye bo phal mo che 'dus shing 'bras sbrang bur ras spen tog a ga ru sman khro ba rgya tshwa glang mon gyi gos dar la sogs pa yul zog gi 'bul ba dang yul chos kyi bsnyen bkur bla lhag pa bgyis shing*/ thams cad la skyabs 'gro bsnyen gnas yi ge drug pa'i chos kyi 'brel pa la sogs pa zhal mjal gsungs thos kyi phrin las bsam mi khyab pas mtho ris dang thar pa'i 'bab stegs su gzhol bar mdzad/ sgar chen nas spyan 'dren gnang ba dang bstun rim pas bteg ste/ bcu gcig pa'i nyer drug la sngar ltar bsu bkod rgya chen po dang bcas sras su phebs nas mjal 'dzom mdzad/ drung du ras spen sogs sku skyos kyi 'bul ba gtos che ba dang*/ sku rtsed khyad mtshar gyi tshul du bur shing dang skyu ru ra rlon pa sogs dang rgya gar gyi phug ron dkar po zhig kyang 'bul ba gnang zhing*/ de gong snga phyir phebs skabs zhor bzhin ma gtogs skor lam la zhabs skor bsgrig ma rang mi gnang kyang*/ 'di res sras mkhar gtsug lag khang dang sbrags pa'i skor lam la nyin bzhin bstar chags su mdzad pa ni gus bkur gyi rgyab mar dgongs pa gtad par mngon/

de nas nang so mdo rgyud pa gshegs khar mtshams sbyor dge ba'i thabs kyi bka' stsal dang phyag dbang byin rlabs sogs gnang zhing*/ de rjes dge rtsa'i tshogs dbur phebs nas bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs yang dag pa gnang*/ de nas bcu gnyis pa'i nyer gcig la bzhugs sgar btegs nas dpon slob spel chung ba'i spyan 'dren ltar rje nyid chos rdzong ngos la phebs shing*/ slar gad mdor yab sras zhal rgyas te bzhugs skyabs/ rgyal tshab sprul sku sogs la jo bo'i byang chub lam sgron nyams khrid mdzad/ de nas yar rgyab pa sogs kyi gdan 'dren mang yang sgar chen mtshur phur sngon du phebs rgyu dang*/ rje nyid dgun bzhugs lho stod du gnang nas/ slar rim pas phebs pa'i sa dpyad shar ba nas lha lung du bzhugs yul 'pho ba dang sbrags lhan rgyas bsnyen bkur la spyan drangs pa na sbrang smyon la brten pa'i sku khams mnyel ba zhig byung nas zhag 'ga' shas sku mtshams gnang*/ de nas re zhig dngas pas sgar chen zla ba bcu gnyis pa phyi ma'i tshes bcu bdun la gad mdo nas btegs/ ja khar zhabs skyel mjal 'dzom du phebs pa sogs mdzad kyang*/ sku mnyel gdeng ma thang 'dra bar sku khams ha cang bde rgyu med tsam zhig la lha lung du dus rim dang chu mo lug lo'i lo gsar smon lam gnang zhing*/ dpa' bo sprul sku la dge bshes dol pa'i be'u bum sngon po rtsa 'grel sogs kyi lung*/ sde pa gsang bdag pas gsol btab ngor mdo sdud pa'i 'grel pa thugs rtsom gnang*/ de nas rim pas sgar chen gar bzhugs su phebs pa'i dgongs pas lha lung nas bteg ste 'brog smad nas brgyud dol du phebs te/ lam bar nas sku khams cung zhig mnyel du song ba'i 'phrod brten la rgyang tsam sku mtshams gnang zhing gsol sman dang sku rim sgo gang gzabs gnang bas gzhi med du ma dngas kyang ngo yod tsam byung bas zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du sku mtshams grol te mtshur phu nas mchog sprul drung nas gnang ba sogs kyi brtan bzhugs rnams bzhes pa dang*/

'jang 'grul ba rdzong ba'i zhal mjal gnang zhing*/ smyug lar khams kyi 'phrod brten rnam sras pho brang du byed rtsis kyis ga dar gyis gsung pa'i bka' shog phyag bris stsal/ lnga pa'i tshes bdun la bshags pas spyan drangs/ gzhung du skor tsam phebs nas sbre zhing du rje mar pa'i gdung khang la phyag mchod smon lam gnang*/ slar dol du phebs/ yar stod nas lcam chos mdzad ma 'das pa'i tshogs mang gi gral dbur yang phebs/ der sog yul nas rgyal po dal jing gi 'bul skyel du bla ma stong nag chu 'phur pa spun dang*/ stong klungs su drung nas dpal 'byor ba gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs pa'ang 'byor/ tshes bcu la dol nas btegs/ 'dre'u snar bzhugs tshugs kha lar sngags grwa slob dpon kar bstan pa sogs phebs skyel zhus pa tshang mar da rung mjal yong gsung pa yin pa la de res mi gsung bas blo yang ma bde ste/ de ka bzhin de nas mjal mi thub pa'i mdzad tshul gang du'ang 'dug zer/ de dag gi skabs su lho byang tshang mar sa g.yo ba chen po lan mang du byung*/ 'phreng por phebs nas sku khams cung mnyel du song bar sde pa thub rgyal bas sku'i 'phrod brten la 'di kar bzhugs par nan zhus kyang sku 'khor kun 'dod pa la/ legs bshad gling par 'gro gsungs nas drug pa'i tshes bcu gcig la phyags bteg/ de skabs spyi chu shin tu che bar phebs bzhud gnang tsa blo bur du bri/ yar lam mtshar ba snar sde bdag chos rje'i dgon gsar la phyag nas gnang*/ bcu bzhir chu shul du phebs te bzhugs/ der bco lnga'i nyin gzim gur la 'ja' shar ba der 'tshogs kun gyis mthong*/ bcu drug la bzad zam khar smyug la ba dang legs bshad gling pa mchod yon gyis bsu ba ser sbreng sogs bkod pa'i khyad par phul du gyur pas chos grwa chen po legs bshad gling gi rnam sras pho brang du gdan phab ste sku mtshams gnang*/ mchog sprul drung nas kyang rnam 'joms dang sgrol dkar gyi gzungs chu'i khrus chab dang bcas pa'i brtan bzhugs 'bul mi gnang*/

rim gyis mnyel bab je lcir song bas phyag mdzod nas de nyid du sgar pa rnams kyi sku rim bskang gso 'dzugs pa/ legs bshad gling pa dang cog grwa/ thel grwa/ 'og min glings sogs nye skor gyi dge 'dun gzhi byes rnams dang*/ mtshur phu yang dge 'dun gzhi byes dang bcas pa rnams la mang ja 'bul 'gyed stobs cher mdzad cing*/ sku rim rtse gcig tu bsgrubs/ nyi shu lnga la rje mchog sprul chibs rags hrag bsdus kyis mtshur phu nas phebs/ nyi shu drug la sgar dang smyug la ba mchod yon gyis bsu bkod ser sbreng dang bcas legs bshad gling du phebs/ 'phral sku gzhogs su phebs te mjal skyes dang brtan bzhugs 'bul ba gnang ba na/ phyag nas kyang mchog sprul drung du bkra shis kha btags zung 'brel dang gser gar blugs kyi rdo rje mu tig gi gzungs thag yod pa zhig mjal skyes su phul/ de nas sku khams mnyel tshul sngon rje brgyad pa dang dpon slob na kha sbug dang yol theg chen rtse tshor bzhugs skabs kyi lo rgyus sogs gsol ja bzhi lnga tsam gyi bar gsung gleng mang po dang dgyes dgyes dpag tu med pa mdzad/ de nas zla ba bdun pa'i nyer gnyis kyi bar phal cher nyin re bzhin dang*/ skabs su gnang chags kyis rje mchog sprul gzim chung du gdan 'dren gnang nas bzhes spro re dang bcas pa'i gsol ja gnyis gsum gyi bar mjal 'dzom dang*/ de skabs phyag mdzod khag tshang ma nas mang ja gsung sgrogs sogs kyi sku rim dar drag tu bsgrubs shing*/ gsol sman gyi 'phrod brten dang*/ rje mchog sprul drung nas kyang brtan bzhugs mang du gnang yang mnyel bab rim lcir song ba'i tshul bstan las nyin gcig dbon gu shri la zhwa dmar ba na rim gyi nang na spyan snga rin po che'i 'og nas nged rang tshe ring ba red ang gsungs pa dang*/ gzim dpon a bo rin chen ba la bla ma tsho dus mchod tshes grangs gcig la 'grig pa byung na dga' rgyu red gsungs pa sogs yun ring mi bzhugs pa'i bka' stsal ci yang gnang*/

de nas nyer gnyis nyin sku khams shin tu zhan par byung bas nang so mchod sprin pa sogs sku 'khris pa rnams kyis sprul pa'i sku phyi ma gang du phebs zhus par bris cha thong gsungs/ phul bas khang pa'i mdun na chu dang zam pa yod pa'i bkod pa mdzad/ de gang na yod zhus pas rje mchog gi sprul skus mkhyen gsungs/ nan gyis zhus pas shar phyogs su phyag mdzub gtad nas 'di ngos na yod kyi brda tsam mdzad de/ de ltar sems can dag bsod nams dang skal pa ches dman pa'i las 'thun tshogs che ba dang*/ sku'i bkod pa de nyid kyis 'dul ba'i gdul bya dang mdzad pa yang de tsam gyis mthar phyin par dgongs nas/ chu mo lug lo gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i nyer gsum la sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings su bsdu pa'i mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan/ de ltar dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa dgu'i bar bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i don la lhun gyis grub cing*/ rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa zhig mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam du dkri bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin las rang gzhan gyi don tshul bzhin du sgrub par nus pa'i slob ma yang rigs kyi khyab bdag rgyal ba mi bskyod zhabs dang dpon slob thun mong gi dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rje nyid kyi slob tshogs kho na dang gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rgyal ba mi bskyod zhabs kyi bka' slob phal mo ches slar yang rje nyid kyi zhabs la gtugs shing bka' drin ma zhus pa med pa las/ gtso bor phyi nang gi yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba 'bri khung chos rje kun spangs rin chen rnam rgyal dang*/ nang so gu'i gung pa mdo rgyud rgya mtsho/ bzhag bla bsod nams lhun grub/ bshad sgrub gling slob dpon kun rin/ 'jang rgyal po'i ti shri drung pa byang chub bshes gnyen la sogs pa dang*/ dge bshes sangs rgyas dpal grub pa dang*/

dpal khang ba karma phrin las gnyis pa/ legs gling gi slob dpon bsod bzang dang*/ shes rab rnam rgyal ba gdan zur/ gsung rab gling slob dpon rab 'byams pa karma phrin las legs grub/ sngags grwa'i slob dpon kar bstan rgya mtsho sogs dang*/ gtso cher sgrub pa bsam gtan pa'i yon tan gyis phyug pa 'jang pa chos rje dang*/ 'jam bu sgom chen/ yang zur gyi bla ma/ g.yung don rin rnam gnyis/ dbon bzod bzang grogs mched la sogs pa dang*/ gtso cher phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas la spobs pa dge bar mdzad pa lha mdongs lo tsā ba bshes gnyen rnam rgyal dang*/ zur mkhar ba karma legs bshad tshol sogs dang*/ gzhan yang dbon ye shes dpal bzang

dang*/ cog grwa bla ma karma legs spyad/ 'ja' mo dge slong karma 'bral med la sogs pa mang du bzhugs shing*/ rje nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i slob ma ni/ gtso bo'am mchog dam pa mtshungs med karma pa dgu pa rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhal snga nas dang*/ rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku grags pa don grub/ si tu sprul sku chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje dpa' bo sprul sku gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ ri bo che'i sku skye karma grags pa rnam rgyal/ kre ho sprul sku karma bslab gsum rgya mtsho sogs dang*/ rigs rus dang yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba sa skya pa rtse gdong bdag chen/ 'bri khung khri thog pa chos rje paṇa chen rin po che dang zur pa'i dbon chos rgyal phun tshogs/ stag lung chos rje kun dga' bkra shis pa khu dbon/ ri bo che'i chos rje mtsho skyes rdo rje/ 'dzom thang chos rje rgyal ba seng ge /zur mang chos rje karma legs bshad sgra dbyangs pa sogs te mdor na skabs der yod pa'i dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi mi chen mkhas grub ston sgom grub pa'i mtha' phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa phal mo ches zhabs la gtugs shing bka' drin nod la/ de dag las gzhan sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin ci rigs par thob pa'i dge 'dun yul phyogs tha dad par yang brgya phrag du ma dang*/ bshad lung man ngag gi bka' drin rgya cher thob pa yang mang du yod la/ gzhan yang theg gsum chos kyi bka' drin ci rigs pa thob pa ni bgrangs kyis mi langs shing*/ mdor na dam pa rnams kyi zad mi shes pa'i phrin las kyi sgo brgya brgyas mtha' klas pa'i gdul bya gang zhig dbugs dbyung mdzad pa dag gcig tu tshad 'dzin du nus pa su zhig go/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa'i gsos sman dam pa gsung gi bdud rtsi yi ger 'khor pa rang gzhung dang gzhan 'grel du mdzad pa ches mang du bzhugs pa/ dbu ma snying po bsdus pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel/

shes phyin dgongs 'grel/ nang don gyi stong thun dang zur bkol mang po/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam bzhag dang*/ phyag chen 'grel pa dang khrid skor mang po/ chos drug dang sbyor drug gi khrid rim zab mo/ dam tshig rgya mtsho'i 'grel pa la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos rmad du byung ba thar pa'i 'jug ngogs su mdzad pa ni rnam grangs sde tshan lngar bsdus pa la glegs bam brgyad tsam du longs pa bzhugs so// de nas nyer bzhi'i nyin rje mchog gi sprul sku nyid phebs nas sku gdung rin po che la phyag mchod dang bkur sti mdzad/ der thams cad bka' gros kyi thog nas zhag shas gsang ba'i khul du mdzad kyang gzim khang steng du 'ja' gur phub pa dang 'ja' zug pa yang dang yang du byung bas phal gyis zhabs pad ma brtan par gleng*/ 'on kyang zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer brgyad par gsang ste/ gsang khog nas sku gdung rin po che yangs can du spyan drangs te gzim chung 'og min du mchod bkod rgya cher bcas te bzhugs/ gsang brtol grub nas sprul sku myur 'byon gsol 'debs 'dzugs pa dang*/ gdung mchod thog ma'i mang bskol sogs gnang ste sgar chen kyang rim pas mtshur phu brgyud yangs can du phebs nas gdung mjal gnang zhing*/ dgu pa'i tshes gsum nas mtshur phu gnas nang yangs can pa zur ri cog grwa sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun mang pos mchod 'bul gyi cho ga mang du btsugs/ tshes bdun gyi nyin me tog gi char bab pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi drangs thad kyi nam mkha' mig gis bzod mtshams la rgya bya gnyis bstod pa byed pa 'ga' zhig gis mthong zer te/ dran nye'i mdo las lha rnams lha'i yul gyi bya la zhon nas skabs su dzam bu'i gling blta ba dang nyul ba la yong bar gsungs pas/ der lha'i bu dag sku gdung la mchod pa'i phyir 'ong ba'i cha shas tsam rje de nyid kyi byin rlabs kyis mthus mthong bar mngon la/

der phyogs mtha'i bla dpon mi chen sde dgon sogs kyi mchod 'bul bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus shing rje mchog sprul rin po che mgon du bzhugs pa'i zhabs 'breng phyag bzhes pa dbon gu shri dang*/ nang so karma mchod sprin pa phyag mdzod gzhi byes sogs kyis mdzad nas phyag rdzas kyi dngos po phal che ba tshang ma sngon rgyal ba mi bskyod zhabs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rje nyid kyis ji ltar gnang ba'i phyag deb la cha bzhag gi dbus gtsang la stod dwags kong yan chad kyi grub pa'i mtha' phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i dge 'dun rnams la mang ja spyi 'gyed dang bla ma slob dpon rnams la mchod bsngo'i rten gyi rnam bzhag /lha sa'i jo bo rin po che'i drung du gser zho phyed dang nyis brgya las grub pa'i maṇḍal gyis gtsos rten gsum rnams la mchod sprin gyi dngos po rgya cher stsal zhing*/ phyag dpe rten mchod sogs sku phyi ma'i sku'i nyer spyad du 'os pa dag ma 'ongs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgor bka' rgya'i tshul du'ang 'jog pa gnang*/ de dag gi skabs su gtso bor rje mchog sprul rin po che'i phyag nas cho ga ba rnams la dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi mang ja rnam bzhag sogs gya nom pa gnang zhing*/ gzhan yang rgyal tshab sprul sku sogs kyis gtsos pa'i sgar chos sde mtshur phu gnas nang yangs can pa sogs kyi kyang mang ja bsnyen bkur 'bul ba rnam bzhag dang bcas pa ci 'byor pa bsgrub/ de nas zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gnyis la klu sdings su ser 'du'i dbur rje mchog sprul rin po che phebs par phyag mdzod gzhi byes nas mchod bsngo'i rten gyi 'bul ba dngos gtsang grangs mang dang*/ bla slob dpon rnams la rnam bzhag dge 'dun spyi la chog yon dpangs bstod pa phul te mchod bsngo gnang nas gdung chog grol zhing*/ tshes bcu gcig la drung 'khor rnams rje mchog sprul rin po che'i zhabs phyir bsdoms/

nyer bdun la rgyu dang cha rkyen 'bad pa gang ci'i thugs khur gtso cher mchog sprul rin po che nyid nas bzhes pa'i phyag g.yog lag len gzim dpon dbon karma bzang ldan gyis bgyis shing*/ bkod pa dang mgo lung bzo rig pa nam bkras sogs sprel lo la bkas bskos te sku gdung gi mchod rten dngul gdung rin po che bzhengs pa'i 'dzugs ston gnang*/ de nas rim pas bde chen du dpon gu shri kar bstan pas nyer mkho'i yo byad thams cad kyi btegs nas bal po bdun gyis bzo grwa tshugs/ bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la bzhugs sgar yangs can nas btegs te/ stod klungs brgyud mtshur phur phebs shing*/ shing pho sprel lo'i sos nas nang so mchod sprin pas do dam mdzad cing bde chen nas shing cha dang 'u lag sogs kyi khur len mdzad nas yangs can du dngul gdung bzhugs yul gyi mkhar las kyang tshugs te/ de dag thams cad rje nyid kyi thugs rje'i byin mthus gegs med par dngul gdung rin po che dpal lha babs kyi mchod rten bang rim la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs gtsos bsdus dang bum sgo'i nang du rten 'dam las grub pa'i rje nyid kyi sku brnyan/ bre la grub chen brgyad/ zla ba la rdo rje ma drug dang*/ nyi ma la gsang chen bka'i sdud po rdo rje chos sam/ gar dbang rdo rje 'chang gi sku gzugs bzhugs pa gser g.yu mu tig padma rā ga sogs rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra rgyan gyis spras pa mtho nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi tshad rten brten pa dang bcas pa me pho khyi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i nang phan chad la legs par grub pas/ zla ba de nyid la rje mchog sprul rin po che yang*/ yangs can du phebs te gdung mjal dang phyag mchod rgyas par gnang*/ gsum par rgyal tshab sprul sku dang sprul sku ba nam bkras sogs kyis phyag g.yog bgyis te/ gzungs gzhugs kyi dbu tshugs nas/ gsum pa'i tshes dgu la sku gdung rin po che bzhugs suu gsol/

lho brag nas rje dpa' bo'i sprul sku dpon slob kyang phebs/ bcu gsum la mchod rten ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i snying po can du grub cing*/ yang zur cog grwa/ mtshur/ gnas nang*/ yangs can/ sgom grwa/ thel grwa sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun sum brgyas lhag pa'i stong phrag tsam chog tshan brgyad du bsdoms pa'i chog grwa dang*/ rje mchog sprul rin po che rdo rje slob dpon du bzhugs pa'i zhabs 'breng yang zur cog grwa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis bgyis pas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa'i sta gon dang*/ bco lnga'i nyin dngos gzhi gnang ba'i rjes dga' ston gyi tshe gtso bor sgar chen dpon slob dang*/ phyogs tha dad pa nas dad stobs kyis 'dus pa du mas 'phan bla bres snyan dar/ mchod rdzas bzang dgu phul/ bcu drug gi snga dro lha rnams kyi mchod pa'i mtshan ma me tog gi char 'bab pa dang 'dab chags yid du 'ong ba dag mkha' la bskor ba byed pa yang 'ga' zhig gis mthong zhing*/ 'jang rgyal blon ti shri dang bcas pa'i snyan dar 'bul rgyu sogs kyang 'byor zhing dge mtshan gyi snang ba dkar pos kun tu khyab par gyur to// de nas bzo bo mgo lung ba dang bcas pa rnams la 'dod dgu'i dngos po gya nom pa'i yon dang rnam bzhag stsal zhing*/ mchod pa nar ma'i cha rkyen bzang po dang bcas sku gdung gi mchod rten bla na med pa 'jig rten lha mi yongs kyi mchod pa'i gnas dang bsod nams kyi zhing mchog dam par bzhugs shing*/ de nas rim pas jo stan dge slong dang kong po mchod gnas sogs dad 'dus 'ga' zhig gis sku tshab kyi sku 'dra rin po che gser zangs las grub pa'ang bzhengs nas rje mchog sprul rin po che nyid kyis rab tu gnas pa mdzad de bla ma lha khang du bzhugs su gsol/ de ltar dpal zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa na rim lnga pa rgyal ba dkon mchog 'bangs kyi rnam par thar pa rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sku tshe'i stod kyi rnam thar rnams dang*/

dge bshes dpal grub pas mdzad pa dang*/ khol bu ba dpa' bo chos 'byung nas 'byung ba/ nyid rang gis mngon du mthong ba dang*/ ngag sgros dag pa las thos pa gung bsgrigs/ rnam thar la bstod pa mi bskyod zhabs kyis stsal ba sogs kyis zur brgyan te mdzad pa yin gsungs pa'i rgyal tshab grags pa don grub pas rgyas bkod gnang ba las/ tshig gi phreng tshogs mang po dag bsdus te skabs don gyi cha shas ji snyed pa tshang mar bgyis te sil mar bkod pa lags so// ༈¿¿go shri grags pa don grub ni/ ru 'tshos snye mo stod bra skor du/ go 'jo khri dpon gyi gdung rigs yab tshe dbang nor bu dang*/ yum legs mdzes sgron ma'i sras su me lug la 'khrungs/ gnas brtan rin rgyal bas mtshan dpal ldan chos skyong rgya mtshor btags/ tshe dbang dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang mdzad/ mi bskyod zhabs kyis drung pa'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin pa'i bka' shog dang*/ phyag mdud dam rdzas smon lam sogs gnang*/ rgya ma pa kun dga' legs ldan las/ rdzogs chen tshe sgrub sogs kyi dbang zhus/ tshar chen la tshe rta dang*/ gur gyi rjes gnang gsan/ dgung lo brgyad par rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag bra gor phebs skabs mjal zhing*/ lcags sprel mchu zlar yangs can du rten gandho la'i drung du yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang zhing dpal ldan grags pa don grub khyab bdag chos kyi nyi ma zhes pa'i mtshan btags/ smon 'jug byang sems dang*/ phag mo dang ma mgon 'khor lnga'i rjes gnang*/ phyag bzhi pa'i dbang bzhi sogs stsal/ mtshur phur phebs/ ber nag can gyi dbang bzhi nod/ rje bdun pas bkra shis rnam rgyal la gnang ba'i dmar ser gyi cod pan gnang te go shri'i khrir mnga' gsol/ yangs can du sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang mdzad/ zhwa dmar lnga pa khams su rje dgu pa spyan 'dren la phebs pa'i zhabs phyir thon/ si tu chos kyi go char grub brgya'i byin rlabs dang karma snyan brgyud zhus/

kre shod lhun po rtser rje dbang phyug rdo rje mjal/ go shri'i chos drug chen mo'i lung dang*/ dus mkhyen bka' 'bum/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i nag rgya phag gsum gyi sgrub skor lung stsal/ sgrol dkar rjes gnang dang nang don ljags bshad gnang*/ lha mo phug dang*/ ra stag dang*/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa'i 'khrungs sa rnams mjal/ der rdo la zhabs rjes byon/ de nas 'dzi kar lha mo dar thang dang*/ 'dzam thang du phebs/ mi bskyod zhabs dang don ldan zhabs kyi bka' 'bum du bzhugs pa'i dbang lung rnams zhus/ rgyal ba seṅge dang mjal/ dar rtse mdo dang rab sgang jo stan sde lnga'i dgon gnas dang kam po gnas nang du phebs/ mar me mdzad mjal/ 'jang dang spo 'bor gyi mjal mi mang*/ rje dang lhan cig rgyud 'bum lung zhus par/ dge slong gzhon nu zhig gis rang byung ba'i brtag gnyis 'grel pa'i glegs bam bstan byung ba rmis shing*/ de phyin chad rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi tshig don kun mkhyen par gyur/ shar phyogs spungs rir sa tham rgyal po'i phrin yig 'byor/ kaṃ po gnas nang brgyud lhun po rtser phebs/ de nas rnam rgyal gling dang mnyan dgon/ zur mang dang sgam sde sogs brgyud de ri bo cher phebs/ 'bum dang nyi khri'i lung*/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi lung rnams gsan/ lha khang dang sku 'bum sogs mjal/ mkha' 'gro 'bum dil du phag mo lha khrid lung*/ dwags la sgam por sku 'dra rin po che mjal/ rang byung pa'i bka' 'bum tshang ma'i lung gsan/ tsā ri mtsho dkar du rje yi khrid gnyer mdzad/ mi bskyod rje yi dbu phar 'dul mdzod kyi ṭī ka'i lung rnams zhus/ phrag tu dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i gnas brtan mdzad/ rtse sgang mdzod nag zhal phyes pa dang*/ dga' ldan ma mo'i mdzod nag zhal phyes/ brag thang du rje brgyad pa'i bka' 'bum lung stsal/ dwags kong gi 'khrug pa bsdum/ de nas rje'i zhabs 'brengs su khram sar phebs/

rje gtsug lag rgya mtshor mdo mang gi lung gnang*/ rab byung dge tshul gyi las slob mdzad/ rje nyid kun bzang nags khrod kyi seng khrir phebs nas re zhig bzhugs stan chags/ rje 'di karma pa dang lhan gcig gtsang du phebs/ dol du mkhan shākya chos rab las grub rgyal zhi ba lha mang sogs kyi dbang gsan/ shar du phebs dus gzings zhi bar mdzad/ lhun po sgang du sa skyong phun tshogs kyi rjes sgrub la phebs/ rnam rgyal sgang du dbyar gnas mdzad/ bra skor du phebs/ yab yum dang mjal/ mtshur phu'i 'du khang gi rab gnas kyi gral du phebs/ spungs ri ba 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal bsnyen rdzogs kyi las slob mdzad/ gtsang rong gi 'khrug pa sdum/ mtshur phur dbu rtse'i rdo rje'achang la rab gnas mdo lugs mdzad pa'i gral du phebs/ rab gnas mdo lugs zhes pa rten rnams sangs rgyas sprul skur bskyed pa la zer ba red/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs mdzad/ mchod gong byang chub chen mo'i sku dang byams khang logs bris rab gnas gral du phebs/ jo bo'i lam sgron gyi khrid zhus/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa gro bzhin gyi nyer gnyis la sku gshegs par gdung mchod 'bul ba sogs bgyis/ sne gdong rtser thugs rje gling pa'i rjes sgrub la phebs/ ma yum la lam rim khrid btab/ 'on rgyal bzang du rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang lam rim khrid sogs gnang*/ yar rgyab dpon chen gyi rjes sgrub la phebs/ rje'i dngul gdung bzhengs par mdzad/

ri bo che'i sku skye grags pa rnam rgyal la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang sogs stsal/ rje chos kyi dbang phyug yangs can khrir phebs pa mjal/ sngags grwa bar brtag gnyis bshad pa mdzad/ gri gur phebs/ theg chen chos rje'i thugs dam rten bye ru'i gshed dmar sku phul ba bzhes/ chos rje mtsho skyes rdo rje dang mjal/ zur mang chos rje dang lho rong go shrīr blo sbyong gi khrid mdzad/ yangs can du phebs/ phyag chen rgya gzhung dpe bum gnyis kyi lung stsal/ stag lo'i smon lam sogs mdzad/ me stag nag zlar sras mkhar du rje dgu pa dang lhan cig tu/ rgyal ba gar gyi dbang po'i drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul mdzad/ grags pa don grub ngag gi dbang phyug rdo rje snying po dga' ba'i phreng ba zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ spyod phyogs kyi byang sdom zhus/ snga phyir rngog dkyil bdun gyi dbang dang dri med 'od kyi lung gsan/ lha mdongs lo chen las dpag bsam 'khri shing gi bshad lung dang*/ rje zhwa dmar thams cad gzigs pa'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa nod par mdzad/ yangs can du phal chen dang dkon brtsegs kyi lung mdzad/ rje gtsug lag phreng ba'i gdung mchod la lho brag tu phebs/ rin spungs ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug gis spyan drangs/ tsandan nags sgrol dang*/ ngur smig sgrol ma mjal/ yangs can du mdo mang lung dang*/ spyod 'jug dang*/ mdo sde rgyan gyi zin thun gnang*/ mtha' rtsar phebs/ phag gru'i sku mjal/ bsam yas dang 'bri khung thal du phebs/ chos rje sku mchod rnams dang lhan cig tu chags lugs rdor phreng gi dbang stsal/ ra sgreng du jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ gser gling pa'i ring srel mchod rten/ sgrol ma g.yul rgyal ma rnams mjal/ mtshur phu'i gser thog gsar bzo mdzad/ zhwa dmar drung nas rdzogs chen rdo rje zam pa'i khrid stsal/ lha mdongs lo tsā las sgra'i ri mo bslabs/

lho brag tuu phebs/ karma pakshi'i bka' 'bum phal cher lung dang*/ sbyong dkyil dbang dang*/ khrom sar 'dul ba'i lung nod/ shangs su sgrol ma'i bum sgrub mdzad tshe bum chu khol zhing nye skor du me tog gi tshal skyes/ sa yos lor mtshur phur rje dgu pa bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i las slob mdzad/ mtshur phur go shrīr dbang bskur/ sne gdongs gong ma yab sras dang*/ mkhan byang bzang par smin grol gyi gdams pa du ma stsal/ si tu sprul pa'i sku/ sprul sku karma grags pa rnam rgyal/ phag mo gdung brgyud/ jo nang tā ra nā tha/ bdag po si tu khu dbon/ bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyal sogs la gang la gang 'tsham gyi chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ ri bo che pas bskul nas/ lam sgron gyi 'grel pa dang dgyes rdor bskyed rim rnam bshad sogs mdzad/ zho khar mnal lam du gar dbang lnga pas bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung stsal ba rmis pas/ mdo sde kun gyi don thams cad thugs su chud/ mtshur phur gnyid kyi 'od gsal ngang nas ra sa'i gtsug lag khang rten dang bcas pa gsal bar gzigs/ bskyed tshal tshogs pa dang*/ 'phags sde'i tshogs par blo sbyangs sogs kyi khrid dang*/ tshe dbang sogs stsal/ zhwa dmar drug pa'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi las slob mdzad cing*/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gyi lung dang*/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung 'bum rnams kyi lung dang*/ rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dbang sogs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du phul/ phag mo'i gdung brgyud sras gsum la/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang phul/ rten bzhengs rnams la rab gnas mdzad/ ba le sangs rgyas dpal bzang sogs la rdor phreng chag lugs kyi dbang bskur gnang*/ sde pa gsang bdag gi yar 'dren la phebs/ thel grwa/ sgom grwa*/ gnas nang rnams su dbang chos mang du gnang*/ ma yum 'das par 'pho 'debs sogs gnang*/ 'phyong rgyas su mi dbang 'das pa'i rjes sgrub la phebs/ legs bshad gling du bshes spring gsungs/

snye thang 'or du phebs*/ rten rnams mjal/ mi'i dbang por tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs bskur/ bya 'dul gyi gnas zul phu mjal/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan la lam sgron bshad pa dang*/ rngog dkyil dbang*/ snyan ngag gzhung bshad sogs mdzad/ rin spungs pa'i rjes sgrub la phebs/ sras nor bu bzang po ma sras kyi dgongs pa bskangs/ lha sar jo shāka rang byon lnga ldan sogs mjal/ dwags por phebs/ rje dgu pa mjal/ bshad sgrub gling du lam sgron gyi khrid mdzad/ bslab gzhi gsal byed dang*/ bshes spring sogs kyi bshad pa gnang*/ gtsang du phebs*/ tre ho sprul skus shangs len mdzad/ shang rnam gling du yos lo'i smon lam grol mtshams rgyal ba'i dbang po zhi dbyings su gzims/ sku gdung mtshur phur spyan drangs te gdung mchod phul/ rje bcu pa spyan 'dren la gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pa phebs skabs rje 'di gzhi bzhugs mdzad/ lcags phag lor sngar gyi seng khrir mnga' gsol grub/ de nas gangs dkar du phebs/ dgung lo re bdun pa glang lo snron zla'i nyar/ mdzod pa karma don dam pa la de ring dkon mchog gi mchod pa rgya chen po shoms/ kho bo chos bkras sogs bar srid kyi sems can mang po'i don byed pa la 'gro dgos gsungs nas sku chos dang snam sbyar nye skor 'dir zhog gsungs/ mdzod pas de lta na sprul sku 'byon min dang*/ 'byon na sa yul gang du sogs zhus pas*/ da rung zhing 'dir bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher byed dgos yod pas skye sa khyed rang tshos tshol dang bde ba rang 'ongs gsungs nas longs skur bzhengs so/ /sku gdung mtshur phur 'od bzhu phul nas/ ring bsrel rnams dngul gdung rin po cher bzhugs su gsol zhing rab tu gnas pa dang mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par mdzad pa'o//
